jobs.description:
Description

Our Programme Managers are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. But as a Program Manager, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

Launch programmes, monitor performance metrics, and report on the status of key objectives that affect deliverables
Use data to understand operational challenges and create continuous improvement initiatives
Work with a variety of other Amazon departments to identify and leverage best practices
Within a programme environment, lead a multidisciplinary team in overcoming challenges and drive progress
Manage stakeholders and internal processes, and define standards

A day in the life

As a Programme Manager, you will be responsible for planning, implementing, and improving initiatives that ensure the smooth running of our operations. You’ll work closely with a range of Amazon colleagues to understand how they work, and what you and your teams can learn, as well as sharing your own expertise. Together, you’ll identify exciting new opportunities and will take the lead when it comes to designing their implementation.

You’ll encourage and support your teams and colleagues to meet important deliverables, while proactively looking for new, data-backed ways we could do things better. Your work will be integral to your team’s success.

About The Team

Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) team. As part of ATS, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.

We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, or Advanced degree
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Experience influencing senior leaders/stakeholders
Experience leading large-scale programs/projects
Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced or master's degree
Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Prince2 certifications, or any other project management certification
Experience in conceptualising and implementing operational or supply-chain management improvements

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Monetization
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

At Snap, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is not a traditional project coordinator—this is a strategic, high-leverage leadership role designed for deep technical operators who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, data analytics, and program execution. TPMs at Snap are single-threaded owners of large-scale, high-stakes, and often ambiguous programs. They combine engineering depth with execution precision, earning visibility and trust across the company by driving outcomes that power the core of our products and infrastructure. Unlike industry-standard TPM roles, Snap TPMs are hands-on contributors who write Python notebooks, build dashboards and automation tools, and partner closely with engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, make architectural trade-offs, and drive the operating rhythm of the business. The most successful TPMs possess the ability to grasp new concepts quickly, navigate technical complexity, and adapt in fast-moving environments. This role is ideal for former engineers or data scientists who have evolved into program leaders without leaving their technical roots behind.

Our interview process reflects the technical rigor and strategic impact expected of TPMs at Snap. Unlike typical program management interviews, our process is designed to evaluate candidates’ ability to think like engineers and act like owners. Candidates begin with a technical screen with the hiring manager that dives into core program execution and engineering fundamentals. From there, The final stage is a virtual onsite, which includes a program leadership presentation and four 1:1 interviews with senior leaders across Snap. Throughout, we assess not only communication and collaboration skills but also technical fluency, first-principles thinking, and the ability to drive strategic outcomes in complex, ambiguous environments.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Snap, you will:

Lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering organizations and require deep technical understanding, rigorous execution, and strategic influence.
Operate as a single-threaded owner (STO) for the most critical programs, managing ambiguity, dependencies, and alignment across diverse technical teams.
Own the full lifecycle of programs—from ideation to execution to operational excellence—delivering outcomes that support Snap’s product, infrastructure, and platform goals.
Partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, influence technical decisions, and drive accountability.
Use hands-on data analytics (Python, SQL, dashboards, notebooks) to guide programs with data, uncover insights, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
Contribute to Snap’s technical ecosystem by building automation tools, improving internal systems, and identifying opportunities for platform-wide transformation.
Work across both development programs (spanning multiple orgs with complex interdependencies) and platform excellence programs (focused on reliability, efficiency, and performance).
Drive the operating rhythm of the business, ensuring engineering systems scale effectively while remaining cost-conscious and performant
Mentor and grow other junior TPMs and Engineers to scale the performance of the org

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
6+ years of experience spanning Engineering / Data Science / Technical Program Management leading cross-functional efforts in the software or tech industry in a data-driven environment.
3+ years of experience in Technical Program Management .
A proven track record of leading large-scale, ambiguous programs across distributed teams in fast-paced, cross-functional environments, especially in the areas of improving platform reliability, operational stability and performance of production systems
Strong proficiency with Python and SQL, and experience using data to analyze systems, build tools, or inform decisions.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Grafana, Looker, Tableau) building dashboards, source control (e.g. GitHub), ticket management (e.g. JIRA).
Experience working directly with engineers and contributing to technical design, architectural trade-offs, and roadmap planning.
Comfort operating with high visibility and accountability; you thrive on ownership and impact.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new domains, systems, and technologies.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

A background in software engineering, infrastructure systems
Prior hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Hive, Kafka, or Flink.
Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization tools like Kubernetes or Docker.
Background in building internal tools or developer platforms to improve engineering velocity and system reliability.
Experience managing production systems, reliability initiatives, or cost optimization programs.
Exposure to high-scale consumer technology or social platforms with strong privacy, performance, or safety requirements.
Strong storytelling and presentation skills—especially with senior engineering or executive audiences.
Masters or PhD in a highly analytical field

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

About INNIO Group

INNIO Group is a global distributed energy solutions provider that delivers reliable, flexible, transient, decentralized, modular and efficient power. With a track record of innovation, INNIO designs, manufactures and services high‑performance power systems under its Jenbacher and Waukesha brands. The company delivers power for applications including data centers, microgrids, grid stabilization, industrial energy and gas compression. INNIO employs over 5,000 people worldwide and is committed to moving energy forward.

Role Summary

The Fulfillment Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of materials and spare parts to support project execution and installation activities. This position focuses on logistics and inventory management, working closely with internal and external teams to maintain material readiness and quality standards. The role requires strong understanding of supply chain processes, ERP systems, and back-office coordination to connect all elements of material planning and fulfillment.

Essential Responsibilities

Oversee material planning and fulfillment to ensure spare parts and components are available for project installation on site
Manage inventory control, receiving, and storage at customer locations and ensure readiness for final installation
Coordinate with Project Management, Requisition Engineering, Global Supply Chain, external packagers, and customers to maintain smooth material flow
Support quality control processes for packaging and material handling
Monitor and maintain ERP system data for accurate material tracking and planning
Develop and implement fulfillment strategies to improve efficiency and meet project timelines
Resolve issues related to material shortages, order discrepancies, or delays in fulfillment
Ensure compliance with company standards for safety, quality, and documentation
Collaborate with internal teams to link supply chain activities and connect operational workflows
Track and report KPIs related to material readiness, fulfillment accuracy, and cost efficiency
Perform other related duties as assigned to assist with successful operations and business continuity

Qualifications/Requirements

High school diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, or a related technical field preferred
Prior experience in material planning, supply chain operations, inventory management, fulfillment, or logistics
Relevant industry experience in power generation, gas compression, or a similar industrial environment supporting reciprocating engines, gas turbines, generators, or comparable industrial equipment.
Experience using ERP systems for material tracking and planning; Oracle experience preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
Willingness to travel approximately 90% to project sites in Missouri and internationally occasionally
Physical ability to work in office, warehouse, and project site environments; move and handle materials or equipment; and lift up to 50 lbs. as needed
Valid driver’s license and passport
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship

Desired Characteristics

Experience supporting material requirements for field installation, commissioning, maintenance, or service activities
Experience working directly with customers, suppliers, field service teams, or other cross-functional stakeholders
Familiarity with parts, components, and material requirements associated with rotating or power generation equipment
Experience working in a project-driven or field service environment

Compensation Range:
$95,520 - $143,280 (Varies depending on relevancy of experience, technical certifications and other job-related criteria)

What We Offer

Medical, dental, and vision benefits
Life insurance and long-term disability coverage
Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
Paid time off and 14 paid holidays
401(k) retirement savings program

jobs.title: Lead Logistics Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Lead Logistics Data Analyst will lead logistics analytics and systems projects that improve service, cost, productivity, and visibility across Honeywell Aerospace. Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Logistics Data Analytics & Systems, this role combines deep knowledge of logistics operations with an understanding of how ERP, warehouse management, transportation management, and reporting systems create and move data. You will translate operational problems into practical process, data, and system solutions, guide cross-functional delivery, and make the results usable by the teams that run the operation.

Responsibilities

Lead assigned logistics analytics and systems projects from problem definition and business case through requirements, delivery, testing, adoption, and benefits tracking. Maintain plans, milestones, risks, decisions, and clear stakeholder updates.
Serve as the logistics process subject matter expert for transportation, warehousing, inventory movement, and related handoffs. Map current workflows and data flows, identify root causes, and design scalable improvements with site and functional partners.
Partner with Logistics, Integrated Supply Chain, IT, Finance, and external providers to define requirements and improve the use and integration of ERP, WMS, TMS, and adjacent systems. Validate that system changes reflect operational reality and preserve data integrity.
Lead analytics work that connects source data to business decisions. Develop or guide SQL queries, data validation, Tableau dashboards, and Python-based analysis or automation as appropriate; establish clear KPI definitions and reconcile results with source systems.
Use logistics metrics to prioritize opportunities and measure outcomes, including cost, on-time performance, warehouse productivity, inventory accuracy, capacity, and exception trends.
Coordinate user acceptance testing, documentation, training, and change management for new reports, processes, and system enhancements. Resolve issues after launch and support sustained adoption.
Identify data quality, control, and compliance risks; partner with appropriate owners on access, governance, export control, and other applicable requirements.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

At least 6 years of progressive experience in logistics or integrated supply chain operations, systems, analytics, or project delivery, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
Working knowledge of transportation and warehouse processes and the operational data generated by ERP, WMS, and TMS platforms.
Hands-on experience using SQL to investigate, reconcile, and analyze operational data and experience building business-facing dashboards in Tableau or a comparable BI platform.
Ability to lead projects across business and technical teams, communicate tradeoffs, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable improvements.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Experience with Python for data preparation, analysis, automation, or forecasting.
Experience implementing or enhancing ERP, WMS, or TMS solutions and documenting system interfaces, data mappings, and end-to-end data flows.
Experience with logistics network, carrier, warehouse, or inventory analytics in a multi-site or global environment.
Experience in aerospace or another complex, regulated supply chain.
Advanced degree, project management certification, or Lean Six Sigma experience.
Ability to coach colleagues on analytical methods and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or a person with protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

The annual base salary range for this position in California is $139,000 - $174,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon MGM Studios Financial Systems
jobs.description:
Description

Ready to lead the successful integration of MGM's financial systems into Amazon?

Join Amazon MGM Studios Tech as the single-threaded owner of a multi-year program that migrates MGM's financial systems and the significant balance-sheet exposure and annual P&L activity they carry, out of multiple legacy platforms and into a single consolidated Amazon architecture. The Principal Technical Program Manager is a leadership role where you'll set strategic technical direction and drive a transformative, cross-organizational initiative spanning multiple business workstreams, a large portfolio of new deal types, across several engineering organizations, and a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, with a firm deadline to fully deprecate MGM's legacy ERP and complete the integration.

What You'll Do

Own and deliver an ambiguous, very large, and complex program that spans multiple organizations and technology domains, serving as the single-threaded owner for all program-level milestones across several bespoke business workstreams (including international and domestic theatrical distribution, third-party content licensing, development and production, streaming, and production facilities).
Design and own the end-to-end data migration and cutover strategy that moves all financial data (master, transactional, and reference data) from legacy systems to the consolidated platform, spanning the full stack across business, middleware, financial automation, downstream financial infrastructure, and legacy systems to deprecate.
Develop workback plans per workstream, sequence migrations to manage operational risk, and coordinate with the studio's legal entity restructure, owning the sequencing trade-offs of its circular dependency with the program's builds.
Own the standardization and graduation framework — define deal-type primitives, establish system-of-record boundaries, enforce standard-versus-exception rules, and determine when each workstream is ready to transition from the program to BAU ownership.
Identify risks and opportunities in technical strategies, system architectures, and engineering organizational structures, resolving cross-workstream dependencies and engineering capacity gaps.
Influence and advise VP-level leadership across multiple Finance Technology and Studios Technology organizations — plus Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FinOps — on technical investment decisions, organizational alignment, and long-term platform strategy, making priority calls based on business value, partner readiness, and platform reuse.
Author the program's strategic narratives, define program-level tenets, and run the operating cadence (monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership, and ad-hoc executive escalations).
Drive clarity in a highly ambiguous environment where business strategy, architectural approach, and even the problem definition may not yet exist.

What You Bring

10+ years of technical program management experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering very large, cross-organizational programs.
Deep expertise in large-scale systems and platform architecture, and the ability to evaluate and influence architectural strategies across multiple engineering organizations.
Executive-level communication and influence skills, with experience advising VP-level leaders and aligning competing priorities across organizational boundaries — without direct line authority.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes at scale.
Experience making irreversible sequencing decisions in complex migrations and managing controllership and operational risk.

Why This Role Matters

As the Principal TPM for this program, you won't just execute, you'll define how MGM's financial systems are successfully integrated into Amazon and rebuilt for the next decade. You'll make the irreversible calls: which businesses cut over first, when to freeze legacy systems, how to manage the circular dependency between the entity restructure and the program's builds, and which requirements to simplify without impacting customers. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives alignment across senior leaders with competing roadmaps, and delivers outsized, measurable business value and productivity impact.

This role reports to a Senior Manager of Software Development and regularly presents to VP-level leadership across the program's Steering Committee.

Join us in building the future of entertainment finance!

About The Team

Prime Video (PV) Financial Systems (FinSys) calculates, pays, receives payments, accounts for and reports all financial activities to operate a digital streaming and studios business. We manage the onboarding of commercial contractual terms and enable seamless monetization of content and assets through mechanisms like PV related purchases, rentals, subscriptions, ads and theatrical releases. We are successful when we have earned the trust of our customers and they are delighted with our solutions. This drives selection growth for Prime Video and the other businesses we support.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
10+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience working at a TV Network, broadcaster, or an online streaming platform, specializing in digital video delivery or streaming media technologies

Job Description

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We’re actively seeking talented Sr. Business Analysts
to join our Operations Transformation team in Newport Beach, CA or Omaha, NE. As a Sr. Business Analyst you’ll move Pacific Life, and your career, forward by bringing an outcome focused perspective to the delivery of Annuity and Life Insurance New Business
process and technology solutions for our Operations teams. You will partner with subject matter experts, business stakeholders, technology and delivery teams to gather, document, validate, and support the delivery of business needs.  This role focuses on execution, coordination, and quality, ensuring that requirements are documented and accurately reflected in process/activity models, technical deliverables and tested solutions.

The salary grade for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

How You’ll Help Move Us Forward

Business Requirements & Documentation

Partner with SMEs and domain leaders to gather and document business requirements under guidance from senior team members, Product Owners, or Technology Leads.
Develop and maintain clear requirement artifacts, including epics, features, and supporting documentation.
Review IT-authored user stories and tasks to confirm alignment with documented business requirements.
Assist in identifying use cases and functional impacts across systems and processes.

Solution Delivery Support

Collaborate with the Product Owner and Technology Lead to understand solution scope, dependencies, and delivery sequencing.

jobs.description:

About The Position

Riverside University Health System (RUHS) seeks candidates for an RUHS Compliance Program Manager position. This role supports the development, coordination, implementation, and oversight of RUHS corporate compliance programs and activities. The selected candidate will supervise support staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations, and perform related duties as required. Current certification in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC)
is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities Include

Supporting compliance with federal, state, and county laws and regulations, including HITECH.
Providing subject matter expertise on medical privacy and information security.
Overseeing staff and managing program activities as assigned.
Assisting in achieving compliance goals and strategic objectives.

The RUHS Compliance Program Manager is a journey-level manager classification reporting to the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer. Incumbents are expected to perform complex and increasingly responsible work with minimal supervision, contributing to the design, execution, and monitoring of effective compliance programs. This position is distinct from the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer, which entails broader responsibilities in directing and managing regulatory compliance programs.

This class has been deemed eligible for the Performance Recognition Plan as set forth under Article 3, Section 311(C) of the County Management Resolution. Program eligibility requires employees to be in a leadership position, manage other employees or programs, and have significant influence on the achievement of organizational objectives.

Why RUHS Medical Center?

Riverside University Health System-Medical Center is nationally recognized for its innovative, progressive care and is considered one of the top employers in the region. The 439-bed Medical Center is a designated Stroke Center, Level I Trauma Center, and home to the only Pediatric ICU in the area.

For more information about RUHS Medical Center, please visit ruhealth.org .

Examples Of Essential Duties

Perform audits to assess compliance with various laws, regulations, policies, and standards such as those related to healthcare fraud, waste and abuse, billing and coding, clinical documentation, privacy and information security, research and ethics; maintain a system of reporting that provides timely and relevant information of all aspects of compliance issues.
Participate in appropriate level of response, develop corrective action plans and conduct compliance investigations while maintaining confidentiality of information reported, as appropriate.
Evaluate departmental continuous readiness to achieve compliance in the areas of healthcare privacy and security; assist in the development and implementation of privacy policies, procedures and breach notification as necessary.
Develop and implement policies and procedures for filing and investigation of complaints related to HIPAA/HITECH Privacy, Breach Notification Rules and related County guidelines and procedures.
Develop and monitor policies and procedures that establish standards for ensuring patient privacy protections, including by providing guidance to individual employees and departments on the HIPAA Privacy Rule, as appropriate.
Document and retain all complaints received as required by HIPAA/HITECH; establish and maintain a mechanism for tracking and reporting the investigation and resolving such complaints.
Develop and administer training for RUHS staff to promote awareness of compliance to regulatory standards.
Provide guidance and assistance to departments on a variety of privacy and compliance auditing, and internal control matters; document findings and prepare reports.
Supervise, assign, review, and evaluate the work performed by staff; direct the day-to-day operations of support staff.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree, preferably with a major in business administration, public administration, public health nursing, finance, accounting, or a closely related field to the assignment. (A master's degree from an accredited college or university in any of the aforementioned majors is preferred.) Possession of current Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC) certification is preferred.

Experience:
Three years of professional, journey-level experience in healthcare compliance, which includes internal auditing experience and experience in the development and implementation of HIPAA and/or privacy compliance programs.

Knowledge of:
Information security; theory, principles and practices of general healthcare; governmental accounting, budgeting and auditing; HIPAA privacy and security rules and regulations; privacy laws, rules and regulations relating to information and security; federal, state and local codes, rules and regulations including healthcare fiscal operations; the methods of developing systems forms for various types of accounting records and reports; information systems and their application to accounting operations; the principles, methods and techniques of public administration, personnel and business office management; the principles and techniques of supervision.

Ability to:
Develop and implement compliance and auditing programs; apply legal and administrative compliance policies to hospital or health systems; analyze data, draw logical conclusions, conduct independent audits, reviews, and make evaluations to ensure compliance issues and concerns are appropriately evaluated, investigated and resolved; recommend effective courses of action; communicate effectively in oral and written form; establish and maintain effective working relationships; conduct independent systems analyses of complex business processes.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

vandePoel Productions is a business-to-business event management and production company specializing in the planning and execution of complex programs. We manage the details that keep an event moving, including attendee registration and travel, hotel and transportation logistics, vendor coordination, production support, and onsite operations.

Since 2009, we have worked as an extension of our clients' teams, providing thoughtful planning, proactive communication, and reliable execution from the first planning conversation through final event closeout. We value integrity, practical problem-solving, continuous improvement, and people who take pride in doing excellent work together.

The Role

The Project Manager leads the planning and delivery of small- to large-scale business events, including in-person, hybrid, registration-focused, technology-enabled, and travel-based programs. This person serves as a primary client contact and coordinates each project from initial planning through onsite execution and post-event closeout.
The right candidate is equally comfortable managing the big picture and the smallest operational details. Success in this role requires sound judgment, proactive communication, strong organization, and the ability to remain calm and resourceful as priorities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Client and Project Leadership
Serve as a primary client liaison, providing proactive guidance throughout program development, execution, and closeout.
Translate client goals into clear project plans, timelines, responsibilities, deliverables, and decision points.
Lead planning conversations to define event content, attendee experience, registration, customer service, travel, transportation, hotel, technology, and onsite logistics requirements.
Identify risks, dependencies, and open decisions early; communicate practical solutions and escalate issues when appropriate.
Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure stakeholders have timely, relevant updates.

Event Operations and Delivery
Coordinate all phases of event delivery, including pre-event planning, production readiness, onsite execution, and post-event reconciliation and wrap-up.
Build and manage detailed project schedules, workback plans, attendee workflows, travel and hotel processes, transportation plans, and onsite materials.
Develop clear, accurate attendee communications in partnership with the client and internal team.
Coordinate with other project managers, customer service, production, registration, and support teams to ensure every workstream is covered.
Travel to meetings and events as needed and provide hands-on onsite leadership and support.

Technology and Attendee Management
Use event and business platforms such as Concur, Splash, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office to manage registration, travel, communications, reporting, and project documentation.
Review event tools and workflows for accuracy, usability, and readiness before launch.
Learn new platforms quickly and help establish efficient, repeatable processes for the team and client.

Vendor and Commercial Management
Manage relationships with travel agencies, hotels, transportation providers, technology partners, and other event vendors.
Source and evaluate new vendors when project needs require additional capabilities or coverage.
Review statements of work, task orders, and contractual requirements to confirm deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and approved changes are understood and tracked.
Support budget awareness by monitoring scope, flagging potential overages, and maintaining organized records for reconciliation.

Qualifications
Five or more years of project management or event production experience, including ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery.
Demonstrated ability to guide cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and keep complex work moving against deadlines.
Meticulous attention to detail, strong critical-thinking skills, and a practical approach to problem-solving.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgment to adapt communication for clients, attendees, vendors, and internal teams.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace; working knowledge of event registration and travel platforms is strongly preferred.
Ability to work independently, take direction, exercise sound judgment, and ask the right questions when information is incomplete.
Comfort working with colleagues, clients, and vendors across multiple time zones.
Ability to remain composed, flexible, and solutions-oriented in fast-moving or high-pressure situations.

How We Work
Event work is collaborative and hands-on. Team members contribute wherever needed, whether that means responding to attendee questions, reviewing hotel lists, assembling onsite materials, solving a last-minute logistics issue, or helping another workstream cross the finish line. We value people who take ownership of the overall event experience and understand that no detail is beneath the team.

Working Conditions
This is a full-time, remote position based from a home office.
Regular event travel and occasional offsite meetings are required.
The role may require early mornings, evenings, weekends, and schedule flexibility before and during events.
The position involves extended periods of computer-based work and, while onsite, may include prolonged standing or walking and handling event materials.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Monetization
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

At Snap, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is not a traditional project coordinator—this is a strategic, high-leverage leadership role designed for deep technical operators who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, data analytics, and program execution. TPMs at Snap are single-threaded owners of large-scale, high-stakes, and often ambiguous programs. They combine engineering depth with execution precision, earning visibility and trust across the company by driving outcomes that power the core of our products and infrastructure. Unlike industry-standard TPM roles, Snap TPMs are hands-on contributors who write Python notebooks, build dashboards and automation tools, and partner closely with engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, make architectural trade-offs, and drive the operating rhythm of the business. The most successful TPMs possess the ability to grasp new concepts quickly, navigate technical complexity, and adapt in fast-moving environments. This role is ideal for former engineers or data scientists who have evolved into program leaders without leaving their technical roots behind.

Our interview process reflects the technical rigor and strategic impact expected of TPMs at Snap. Unlike typical program management interviews, our process is designed to evaluate candidates’ ability to think like engineers and act like owners. Candidates begin with a technical screen with the hiring manager that dives into core program execution and engineering fundamentals. From there, The final stage is a virtual onsite, which includes a program leadership presentation and four 1:1 interviews with senior leaders across Snap. Throughout, we assess not only communication and collaboration skills but also technical fluency, first-principles thinking, and the ability to drive strategic outcomes in complex, ambiguous environments.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Snap, you will:

Lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering organizations and require deep technical understanding, rigorous execution, and strategic influence.
Operate as a single-threaded owner (STO) for the most critical programs, managing ambiguity, dependencies, and alignment across diverse technical teams.
Own the full lifecycle of programs—from ideation to execution to operational excellence—delivering outcomes that support Snap’s product, infrastructure, and platform goals.
Partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, influence technical decisions, and drive accountability.
Use hands-on data analytics (Python, SQL, dashboards, notebooks) to guide programs with data, uncover insights, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
Contribute to Snap’s technical ecosystem by building automation tools, improving internal systems, and identifying opportunities for platform-wide transformation.
Work across both development programs (spanning multiple orgs with complex interdependencies) and platform excellence programs (focused on reliability, efficiency, and performance).
Drive the operating rhythm of the business, ensuring engineering systems scale effectively while remaining cost-conscious and performant
Mentor and grow other junior TPMs and Engineers to scale the performance of the org

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
6+ years of experience spanning Engineering / Data Science / Technical Program Management leading cross-functional efforts in the software or tech industry in a data-driven environment.
3+ years of experience in Technical Program Management .
A proven track record of leading large-scale, ambiguous programs across distributed teams in fast-paced, cross-functional environments, especially in the areas of improving platform reliability, operational stability and performance of production systems
Strong proficiency with Python and SQL, and experience using data to analyze systems, build tools, or inform decisions.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Grafana, Looker, Tableau) building dashboards, source control (e.g. GitHub), ticket management (e.g. JIRA).
Experience working directly with engineers and contributing to technical design, architectural trade-offs, and roadmap planning.
Comfort operating with high visibility and accountability; you thrive on ownership and impact.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new domains, systems, and technologies.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

A background in software engineering, infrastructure systems
Prior hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Hive, Kafka, or Flink.
Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization tools like Kubernetes or Docker.
Background in building internal tools or developer platforms to improve engineering velocity and system reliability.
Experience managing production systems, reliability initiatives, or cost optimization programs.
Exposure to high-scale consumer technology or social platforms with strong privacy, performance, or safety requirements.
Strong storytelling and presentation skills—especially with senior engineering or executive audiences.
Masters or PhD in a highly analytical field

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next-generation ML accelerator is a multi-die chiplet using advanced 2nm and 3nm process nodes with state-of-the-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape-out and into production readiness.

This is not a status-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape-out critical.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.

About The Team

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with multi-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2.5D/3D integration).
Familiarity with HBM integration, die-to-die interfaces, or high-speed serial subsystems.
Experience with leading-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
Background in ML accelerator or high-performance compute silicon.
Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large-scale chip development programs.

If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from "doing digital" to "being digital" by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.

Recruiting for this role ends on May 31, 2027

Work you'll do

As a Deloitte Senior, Business Analyst, you will be responsible for understanding the business needs, models, trends, and transformation vision. You will identify changes required to meet the business need by consideration of organization structure, business functions, required knowledge and skills, processes and technology. You will explore possible solutions by coordinating with technical architects for discovery and demonstrate how proposed solutions are aligned to business goals and objectives and define the impacts and risks.

Responsibilities:

Use business goals and objectives to assist Product Owners in developing a product roadmap.
Perform business analysis tasks and/or coordinate tasks across the Service Delivery Transformation program.
Identify solution options that meet the business need, then coordinate with delivery teams to determine the best solution approach.
Assist Product Owners in defining release scope, including defining benefits and risks during the discovery phase.
Develop supporting artifacts including requirements, solution options, recommendations, business flows, where required.
Make connections with other initiatives in place, underway or planned across other parts of the organization that need to be considered.
Work with architects and delivery teams to ensure the functionality meets the needs of the enterprise and aligns to the overall vision.
Ensure the business is aware of emerging trends, practice, and technologies and how they may contribute to business outcomes and strategies.
Actively identify and champion innovation initiatives supporting the business strategy.
Develop and maintain productive and collaborative relationships with Product Owners, and various SMEs across the organization to support Service Delivery Transformation efforts.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Strong business analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical solution options.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with confidence engaging Product Owners, architects, SMEs, and delivery teams.
Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, able to work effectively across functions and influence without formal authority.
Agile and adaptable mindset, with the ability to manage shifting priorities, support transformation efforts, and contribute to innovation.

The Team

Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

The Sr. Project Manager (MEP) will be covering all aspects of reporting, time, cost, risk and scope management oversight. Coordination of all MEP project management matters, in collaboration with the relevant project stakeholders.

To lead the team in managing the project inclusive of cost planning, consultant and contractor procurement, design management, construction management until project completion and handover.
Be responsible for the on-programme, on-cost, on-quality delivery of the Services, comprising the shell and core of the project and fit-out phases as required.
Proactively manage the authority application of all required utilities.
Undertake project control functions including project reporting, risk, cost and schedule
Ensure that appropriate management tools are set up to help the team control the project;
Create a cost-minded atmosphere within the team;
Provide proactive project management services from commencement through to completion and handover in order to attain successful on-programme, on-cost, on-quality delivery of the Services as required.

Track cost, programme and quality throughout the project and issue monthly formal reports to the Employer including recommendation of progress claim and payment to appointed Main-Contractor.
Maintain photographic records detailing progress of the Services on a weekly basis and ad-hoc as required.
Manage all coordination and communications between project stakeholders including, but not limited to, the Employer, Design Consultants, Cost Management Consultant and Main-Contractor teams.
Prepare the Employer’s and stakeholder presentations/reports as required for stage sign-off or key milestone events.
Support the Employer in providing information to prospective customers.
Any other work related tasks or duties deemed required and assigned by the management / line manager.

jobs.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Preconstruction Project Manager – Energy Storage is responsible for leading the Energy Storage Preconstruction Group’s efforts with daily management, coordination, and successful completion of the energy storage project scope, budget, and schedule from notice of award to project mobilization. Additional responsibilities include managing project meetings, performing cost comparisons, updating project schedules, managing contract exhibits through execution, and strategic buyout negotiations as needed to maintain budget.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

Able to perform all Preconstruction Project Manager job responsibilities
Maintain cost control ledger and job cost statements
Prepare billings and expedite payments
Set up and maintain all aspects of the CMiC system
Prepare bid packages and solicit and evaluate bids
Write project procedures
Review plans for completeness and accuracy
Supervise and train Preconstruction Project Engineers and clerical staff
Ensure procurement activities align with LNTP scope, budget, and schedules
Collaborate with the business development, engineering, accounting, construction, and legal departments to create contract scopes of work
Work with Engineering and Procurement to understand design constraints and material lead-times to ensure long lead procurement items are appropriately released during the LNTP phase
Define and create LNTPs
Research and understand project specific design requirements (internal requirements, owner/contract requirements, and permit requirements)
Liaison with the Engineering Manager to track changes that impact project schedule and/or budget and provide those changes to the Project Executive
Represent SOLV Energy in owner meetings
Support estimating reconciliation for each design iteration
Maintain timely and accurate reporting to the Project Team and management, specifically cost forecasting and estimated cost at completion
Effectively manage project risk; evaluate probability and severity of risk events as they are identified / anticipated and prepare mitigation plans with project team operations management
Develop and maintain good relationship with Owner, Engineers, Vendors and Subcontractors; develop strategies and skills to build a strong partnership with the Owner, while still ensuring prompt owner notification of impacts and preservation of rights under the EPC

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements: 

Minimum 3 years of Energy Storage Construction Experience.
Engineering, Construction Management or Architectural degree, or equivalent experience
Thorough understanding of plans and specifications
Field experience (5-8 years, Project Engineer or Assistant Superintendent)
Leadership ability – able to pull together team members from diverse backgrounds in a remote environment and organize them into a cohesive, high-performing project team
Effective written and verbal communications skills and organizational skills
Strong computer skills with MS Office suite, as well as other industry-standard tools, such as Bluebeam Revu
Fundamental knowledge of contract law and project accounting
Organizational and communication skills; must have strong people skills
Detail-oriented, motivated self-starter
Able to travel (estimated 25%)
5+ years construction experience
2+ years scheduling and estimating experience

jobs.title: Senior Environmental/Remedial Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

The GE Vernova Environmental & Properties Risk team in the GE Vernova Supply Chain Development organization provides strategic and technical support to manage environmental risk across the GE Vernova global footprint. As a member of this team, this Senior Project Manager will serve as a lead project manager for a portion of GE Vernova’s portfolio of remedial projects. In addition, this Senior Project Manager will serve a key support role for the assessment and mitigation of environmental risk in transactions – including mergers & acquisitions, real estate and restructuring activities – and strategic initiatives. This Senior Project Manager will work closely with team members from Environmental & Properties Risk, real estate, sourcing, special projects, strategy, finance, legal, EHS, governmental affairs, communications, operations, and facilities to provide technical leadership and coordination.

Job available in multiple locations

Remote, United States of America
Remote, Brazil
Remote, Mexico

Job Description

What you’ll do

In serving as a Senior Project Manager within the Environmental & Properties Risk team you will be responsible for managing the investigation and remediation of a portion of GE Vernova’s portfolio of remedial projects through the management of external consultants and coordination with key internal stakeholders. This role will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the assigned remedial project execution, from initial risk review and project planning to final completion, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, safety standards, and budget constraints. These responsibilities include technical delivery, schedule management, fiscal management, serving as an internal and external stakeholder liaison, reporting requirements, and coordination with project team members. In addition, this Senior Project Manager will provide technical support for other critical functions within the Environmental & Properties Risk group such as M&A, real estate and restructuring activities.

Qualifications

General Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited University or College in environmental science, geology, engineering, biology, chemistry, or equivalent discipline.
Solid proven applied experience in project management experience in environmental, remediation, environmental transactions and/or EHS within a company, regulatory agency and/or consulting firm.
Minimum of:
Solid proven experience managing complex remediation projects involving soil, groundwater and soil vapor issues, including experience with PCBs, hydrocarbons, and chlorinated solvents; and/or
Solid proven experience in providing environmental transactional support for real estate and/or M&A transactions including:
Expert familiarity with ASTM standards and processes for assessing risk via Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments.
Demonstrated experience preparing/using Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments to assess risks; and
Experience coordinating environmental due diligence efforts for multiple, simultaneous, large, and/or complex transactions.

Ability to understand materiality, risks and trade-offs relative to other considerations.
Understanding of legal requirements, regulatory environment, environmental risk, reputational considerations, local issues, etc.
Provide strategic oversight, direction and communication including planning, progress, and financial updates to management on projects.
Proven ability to manage and coordinate consultant teams to generate project cost estimates, scopes of work, proposals, and reports.
Experience preparing financial estimations and planning necessary for long-term projects.
General familiarity relevant environmental issues and considerations related to historical and current manufacturing and energy operations.
Strong attention to detail.
Excellent communication and presentation (oral/written) skills; public presentations both in person and virtual are an essential part of job function.
Demonstrated collaboration skills within diverse teams.
Ability to clearly communicate complex technical information in an easy-to-understand manner.
Demonstrated success in coordinating technical, financial, reputational and legal considerations for complex projects.
Strong technical and analytical aptitude to understand and articulate complicated trade-offs.
Experience working with sensitive and confidential information.
Experience working cross-culturally in large, matrixed organizations and ability to navigate geographies, cultures, relationships, etc.
Ability and willingness to travel including internationally (~30% travel).
Proficiency with MS Office Programs including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
English proficiency and a minimum of business fluency in at least one of the following languages: Spanish or Portuguese.

Qualifications That Will Make You Stand Out

Graduate degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, biology, chemistry, business or relevant related discipline.
Highly collaborative person with outstanding communication skills.
Strategic and flexible thinker who uses a 360 degree perspective to assess risks.
Ability to problem-solve creatively, to be flexible and think outside the box.
Ability to see big picture while not losing sight of critical details.
Ability to be flexible, follow tight deadlines, and deliver results quickly.
Ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Demonstrated project management skills including project initiation, scoping, resorting, scheduling, budgeting, risk management and communication.
Great energy and enthusiasm for position and environmental risk management.
Fluency or familiarity with additional prominent language(s) such as Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Mandarin, or Vietnamese.
Familiarity with LEAN principals.

Benefits Available To You

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In order to meet this mission, we provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce: Our Culture | GE Vernova (gecareers.com)

Our compensation & benefits are designed to help you manage your personal and family needs, while rewarding high performers. We offer a robust benefits package depending on your employment status and your national requirements.
A healthy, balanced lifestyle can mean different things to different people. We've created programs that support the way you live and work today.
GE Vernova invests to provide opportunities to grow your career by providing a path for continued on-the-job learning and development.

Inclusion & Diversity

At GE Vernova, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive
culture
, where everyone feels empowered to do their best work because they feel accepted, respected and that they belong. Click here to learn more: https://jobs.gecareers.com/vernova/global/en/i-d-e

Project Coordinator / Technical Project Manager – Software Development
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator / Technical Project Manager – Software Development Location:
India – Remote
Employment:
Full-time employee of Trilogy India
Experience:
3–6 years
Team Alignment:
Works closely with Trilogy NextGen US
Work Hours:
India-based schedule with flexibility to overlap with US business hours when needed
About the Role Trilogy India is looking for a mid-level Project Coordinator / Technical Project Manager
to help lead multiple software-development projects and coordinate the work of developers across our India and US teams.
This is not a role for someone whose primary skill is updating spreadsheets and scheduling meetings. We need someone who can take ownership of delivery, keep developers moving, identify blockers, drive work to completion, and communicate clearly with Trilogy NextGen leadership in the US.

Just as importantly, we want someone with good judgment.
We do not
want a project manager who blindly drives a team toward the wrong deliverable simply because it was written in a ticket. The right person knows when to move independently and when to stop, recognize ambiguity, and ask the right question before the team spends days building the wrong thing.
What You'll Do Coordinate multiple software-development projects and workstreams simultaneously.
Manage day-to-day delivery across several developers and technical resources.
Translate business objectives and discussions into clear tasks, priorities, milestones, and expected outcomes.
Drive assigned work through to actual completion
, not simply status reporting.
Track commitments, dependencies, blockers, risks, and delivery dates.
Follow up proactively with team members and ensure commitments do not disappear between meetings.
Conduct regular project and developer check-ins without creating unnecessary process or meetings.
Work directly with Trilogy NextGen's US leadership and technical teams to clarify priorities and requirements.
Identify unclear or conflicting requirements before significant development effort is wasted
.
Ask thoughtful questions when requirements, priorities, or expected outcomes do not make sense.
Escalate issues early with context, potential impact, and recommended next steps.
Help developers stay focused on the highest-priority work.
Coordinate testing, reviews, approvals, and production readiness.
Maintain concise project documentation and communicate progress to stakeholders.
Help improve delivery processes as the Trilogy India development organization grows.

What We're Looking For 3–6 years of experience
in project coordination, technical project management, software delivery, or a similar role.
Experience coordinating software developers and multiple concurrent development projects
.
Excellent spoken and written English communication skills
.
Ability to communicate confidently with US-based technical and business leadership.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously.
Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment.
A strong sense of ownership — if something is assigned to your team, you stay with it until it is completed or clearly escalated.
Ability to recognize when information is missing, requirements are unclear, or a team may be heading in the wrong direction.
Confidence to stop and ask the right questions rather than blindly execute
.
Ability to distinguish between situations where you should make a reasonable decision yourself and situations where leadership input is necessary.
Comfortable holding developers accountable while maintaining a collaborative working environment.
Ability to summarize complex issues clearly and concisely.
Comfortable working with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Teams, Slack, or similar project-development platforms.
Willingness to flex working hours to collaborate with US teams when projects, meetings, or critical issues require it
.

Preferred Qualifications Experience working with distributed India/US development teams.
Background supporting Agile software-development teams.
Technical understanding of APIs, web applications, cloud platforms, databases, AI, or software-development concepts.
Experience coordinating developers across front-end, backend, data, AI, QA, or DevOps workstreams.
Experience with logistics, manufacturing, supply chain, financial services, or enterprise technology projects.
Familiarity with AI tools for meeting summaries, requirements analysis, documentation, project tracking, or productivity.

The Person We're Looking For The right person is organized without being bureaucratic, persistent without being abrasive, and independent without operating in a vacuum
.
We want someone who can hear:
"Here is what we're trying to accomplish."

…and turn that into an organized plan, coordinate the right people, keep the work moving, and get it delivered.
But we also expect you to recognize:
"Something about this doesn't add up. Before I send three developers down this path, I need to ask a question."

That judgment is as important to us as project-management experience.
Working With Trilogy NextGen US This role is employed by Trilogy India
and works closely with Trilogy NextGen's US leadership, customers, and development teams.
The position is remote within India
. We are not requiring a permanent US-hours schedule, but candidates must be comfortable adjusting their schedule when necessary for important planning sessions, customer discussions, project reviews, releases, or critical delivery issues.

If you are a self-directed project leader who enjoys turning ambiguity into execution while still knowing when to ask "Are we sure this is what we should be building?" — we'd like to talk to you.
