jobs.description:
IT starts with us! Wir können seit 25 Jahren Colocation und Internet und bieten ein breites Betätigungsfeld für ITler*innen, Ingenieur*innen, Elektrotechniker*innen und Kaufleute.

Wir vernetzen "alles und jeden", planen, errichten und betreiben erfolgreich Rechenzentren mit 100% Ökostrom und sind nach der DIN EN ISO/IEC 27001:2022 und DIN EN ISO 50001:2018 zertifiziert.

Wir sind Teil einer starken Community und sitzen im Herzen von Berlin.

Unsere Kunden sind vielfältig – IT-Unternehmen aus Berlin und Brandenburg schenken uns genauso ihr Vertrauen wie weltweit agierende TOP „Trillion-dollar companies“.

Wir sind seit vielen Jahren der führende Datennetzknoten im Osten Deutschlands und wachsen stetig und mit Begeisterung an dieser Herausforderung.

Um unsere strengen Sicherheitsstandards nach ISO 27001 und EN 50600 (sowie kommend NIS2 und KRITIS) kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und den Betrieb vor Ort zu steuern, suchen wir für das Team ACCESS der Abteilung Data Center Management am Standort Berlin ab sofort einen Experten für die physische Sicherheit unserer Rechenzentren.

Security Manager Data Center (m/w/d)

Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption & Weiterentwicklung: Planung, Projektierung und Optimierung von physischen Sicherheitskonzepten (u. a. automatisierte Zutrittskontrollsysteme (ZuKo) und Einbruchmeldeanlage (EMA), komplexe Schließanlagen, modernste Videoüberwachung / CCTV und Perimeterschutz)
Dienstleistersteuerung: Fachliche Führung, Einweisung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auditierung des externen Sicherheitsdienstes vor Ort (KPI-Überwachung, Kontrolle von Maßnahmen).
Technisches Partnermanagement: Koordination und Steuerung von Systemhäusern und Errichtern bei der Wartung, Modernisierung und dem Ausbau der Sicherheitstechnik nach definierten Sicherheitszonen.
Risiko- und Vorfallsmanagement: Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Erstellung von Sicherheitskonzepten, konzeptionelle Betrachtungen, Untersuchung sowie Auswertung von Sicherheitsvorfällen und Einleitung von Präventivmaßnahmen.
Compliance & Audits: Vorbereitung und Begleitung von internen und externen Sicherheitsaudits (z. B. ISO 27001, SOC 2, Kundenaudits) sowie Erstellung von Sicherheitsberichten für das Management

JOB DESCRIPTION

The FTO connects teams across Oracle to improve how Federal Consulting delivers. The office removes barriers, connects expertise, and advances systemic solutions across four areas: delivery excellence, operational improvement, automation and time to value, and reporting and tooling.

As a Lead Federal Project Manager, you will independently lead multiple FTO initiatives end-to-end, from request intake and planning through implementation, adoption, and closure. You will translate broad priorities and recurring delivery challenges into actionable plans, coordinate accountable owners, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries. You will lead the assigned transformation projects and coordinate the changes needed to help those teams succeed.

This role requires an experienced project leader who understands Federal program environments, navigates ambiguity, and earns trust with senior leaders and working teams. This role is in Louisville, KY or Maple Grove, MN
The workday will begin around 7:00AM
The role works a 9/80 schedule where you will have every other Friday off
There may be up to 20% travel including international travel

The Program Manager Is Accountable For The Following

Managing scope to achieve cost/profitability, schedule, and technical performance objectives
Performing as a Control Account Manager (CAM)
Establishing program direction for the matrixed team delivering the scope (operations including supply chain and manufacturing, engineering, field service, and/or others)
Proactively planning for activities on current and future contracts
Monitoring and controlling activities on current contracts including disciplined, effective change management
Actively and effectively managing risks and opportunities
Indirectly managing and leading program team members across several functions
Making timely decisions with sound judgment while complying with policies and procedures
Continuously improving program performance including capturing, evaluating, and sharing good practice
Meeting financial commitments for orders, sales, profit, and cash flow

Responsibilities and day-to-day activities within this role include the following:

Responsible for completion of deliverables and on-time delivery
With respect to production, manages material for and manufacturing of hardware including final processing, shipment and delivery planning and coordination, and quality and export reviews
Manages operations, quality, engineering, field service, and supporting functional resources to deliver program scope
Partners with project controls to develop and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and manages program team’s performance to the IMS
Develops, creates, and reports on key program metrics including on-time delivery, material forecasts, hardware production and delivery forecasts, resource allocation, and performance to labor and material budgets
Identifies and assesses performance gaps to customer expectations or program objectives, develops and initiates improvement plans to close the gaps, and utilizes metrics to verify performance to plan
Supports recurring status meetings with the program team and customer and program review meetings with business and customer leadership
Hosts customer meetings at the Louisville factory and our Minneapolis location including coordinating visits with export and security functions
Facilitates and attends source inspections and other supplier/subcontractor meetings and/or visits
Flexes schedule due to time zone differences when supporting customer meetings
Successfully navigates through cultural differences to understand unique customer customs, expectations, values, and priorities

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree and 6 years of work experience or equivalent experience
Customer focus and relationship building skills
Interest in deepening international culture awareness, understanding, and experience
Experience in Project Management
Experience in Scope Management
Knowledge of project management methodologies, toolsets, process, and governance
Ability to develop and implement effective program/project plans specifying goals, staffing, scheduling, identification of risks, contingency plans, and allocation of available resources
Ability to initiate, prioritize, and coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously
Ability to achieve program objectives using a team-based approach that demonstrates the value of each team member
Ability to operate independently and proactively

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

International business knowledge
International culture awareness, understanding, and experience
Graduate Degree
Professional Certifications (PMP)
Experience in Defense (DoD)/Government Contracting
Experience in a Firm Fixed Price Environment
Experience in Engineering/Technology
Experience in Operational Excellence (OE)
Experience in Control Account Management (CAM)
Experience in Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)
Experience in Lifecycle Management (LCM)
Experience in Oracle or ERP
Advanced Excel skills

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Platforms & Services

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

The Platforms & Services (P&S) sector under BAE Systems, Inc does the big stuff: the armored combat vehicles, naval guns, missile launchers, and naval ship repair…just to name a few. Our employees take pride in the work they do and why they do it. They are on the front lines every day, building our products to protect the lives of those who serve. We may be biased, but we think P&S does some of the coolest work around, and we think you will too.

Company Overview

Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our purpose is to empower easy, data-driven decision-making on important healthcare questions. Through our products, education, and services, MedInsight is making an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing waste. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.

MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.

Position Summary

Milliman MedInsight is seeking a Product Strategist to support the development and commercialization of emerging healthcare data, workflow, and AI-enabled decision-support products, with a strong focus on 0-to-1 opportunities and emerging product lines. This role serves as a collaborative bridge between data products, technology partners, and downstream product lines, working across payer, provider, clinical, GMs, and technical product management teams to incubate differentiated products. The Product Strategist will translate market needs and business priorities into actionable product strategies, leveraging internal capabilities, external data assets, and technology partnerships to advance innovative concepts into scalable, market-ready solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

Product Incubation & Commercialization: Develop business cases, product definitions, and product concept memos for assigned opportunities, articulating the market opportunity, target buyer, value proposition, competitive differentiation, proposed solution, and path to commercialization. Drive incubation of emerging healthcare data, workflow, and AI-enabled decision-support products that may leverage hyperscalers, technology partners, intelligent agents, and reusable platform capabilities as delivery mechanisms.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with payer, provider, clinical, general managers, technical product management, and engineering stakeholders to align customer value propositions with the underlying data, models, workflows, delivery mechanisms, and compliance requirements.
Product Roadmap Development: Support product roadmap development in collaboration with Technical Product Managers by documenting capabilities, dependencies and priorities.
Strategic Partnerships: Support execution with technology partners (such as Databricks) and external partners to prototype, execute joint data strategies, and accelerate enterprise/build capabilities.
Build vs Partner Evaluation: Collaborate with lead Strategic Product Managers such as Payer, Provider and Clinical to identify where software partnerships may advance path to market/differentiation. Support partner sourcing, capability evaluation, and business and technical due diligence.
Discovery and Market Synthesis: Conduct market, customer, and competitive research to identify emerging opportunities and inform product and portfolio strategy.
Data Acquisition & Ecosystem Sourcing: Support business value articulation, evaluation, and onboarding of external data assets and partnerships to enrich the core assets and expand addressable market use cases.
Proof-of-Concept Design & Prototyping: Drive the execution and evaluation of technical and commercial proof-of-concepts (POCs) with partners to mitigate risk of new product initiatives before full-scale engineering investment.
Product Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a product subject matter expert supporting internal training, client discussions, pre-sales and sales activities, and commercialization efforts as appropriate.
Responsible Innovation: Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage dependencies, and ensure assigned initiatives meet data-governance, privacy, contractual, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, computer science, engineering or related field.
5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, strategy consulting, commercialization, or a related discipline, preferably within enterprise software, healthcare data and analytics, or technology-enabled services. Experience with clinical and pharmacy data, data-as-a-service, APIs, interoperability, and FHIR is preferred.
Proven ability to conduct market discovery, create business cases, define product packaging, monetization models, and go-to-market strategies for data assets, solving complex financial and clinical pain points.
Strong understanding of product strategy, commercialization, platforms, product development lifecycles, and business planning.
Track record collaborating with cloud providers such as Azure, Databricks, AWS and or GCP to execute joint technology strategies or co-innovation initiatives with strong hybrid business and tech skills to speak with both business and engineering audiences.
Familiarity with AI/ML models, intelligent agents, and financial/clinical workflow automation including using AI tools to enhance day-to-day research, analysis, synthesis, and productivity
Experience using SQL, BI, and analytics tools to conduct exploratory analysis, validate hypotheses, and support product strategy, commercialization, and proof-of-concept activities.
Demonstrated success supporting external data partnerships, third-party vendor integrations, rapid POC commercialization, and translating multi-stakeholder mandates into scalable product capabilities.
Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with experience using frameworks to evaluate market opportunities and inform product strategy. Ability to present recommendations, business cases, product concepts, and complex information to clients, cross-functional teams, and MedInsight senior management.

Location:

This is a remote position. Candidates hired into this role may work remotely anywhere in the US. The expected application deadline for this job is October 30, 2026.

jobs.title: Product Strategist – New and Emerging Products (MedInsight)
jobs.description:
Individual(s) must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for immigration support or sponsorship from Milliman now or in the future.

Company Overview

Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our purpose is to empower easy, data-driven decision-making on important healthcare questions. Through our products, education, and services, MedInsight is making an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing waste. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.

MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.

Position Summary

Milliman MedInsight is seeking a Product Strategist to support the development and commercialization of emerging healthcare data, workflow, and AI-enabled decision-support products, with a strong focus on 0-to-1 opportunities and emerging product lines. This role serves as a collaborative bridge between data products, technology partners, and downstream product lines, working across payer, provider, clinical, GMs, and technical product management teams to incubate differentiated products. The Product Strategist will translate market needs and business priorities into actionable product strategies, leveraging internal capabilities, external data assets, and technology partnerships to advance innovative concepts into scalable, market-ready solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

Product Incubation & Commercialization: Develop business cases, product definitions, and product concept memos for assigned opportunities, articulating the market opportunity, target buyer, value proposition, competitive differentiation, proposed solution, and path to commercialization. Drive incubation of emerging healthcare data, workflow, and AI-enabled decision-support products that may leverage hyperscalers, technology partners, intelligent agents, and reusable platform capabilities as delivery mechanisms.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with payer, provider, clinical, general managers, technical product management, and engineering stakeholders to align customer value propositions with the underlying data, models, workflows, delivery mechanisms, and compliance requirements.
Product Roadmap Development: Support product roadmap development in collaboration with Technical Product Managers by documenting capabilities, dependencies and priorities.
Strategic Partnerships: Support execution with technology partners (such as Databricks) and external partners to prototype, execute joint data strategies, and accelerate enterprise/build capabilities.
Build vs Partner Evaluation: Collaborate with lead Strategic Product Managers such as Payer, Provider and Clinical to identify where software partnerships may advance path to market/differentiation. Support partner sourcing, capability evaluation, and business and technical due diligence.
Discovery and Market Synthesis: Conduct market, customer, and competitive research to identify emerging opportunities and inform product and portfolio strategy.
Data Acquisition & Ecosystem Sourcing: Support business value articulation, evaluation, and onboarding of external data assets and partnerships to enrich the core assets and expand addressable market use cases.
Proof-of-Concept Design & Prototyping: Drive the execution and evaluation of technical and commercial proof-of-concepts (POCs) with partners to mitigate risk of new product initiatives before full-scale engineering investment.
Product Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a product subject matter expert supporting internal training, client discussions, pre-sales and sales activities, and commercialization efforts as appropriate.
Responsible Innovation: Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage dependencies, and ensure assigned initiatives meet data-governance, privacy, contractual, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, computer science, engineering or related field.
5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, strategy consulting, commercialization, or a related discipline, preferably within enterprise software, healthcare data and analytics, or technology-enabled services. Experience with clinical and pharmacy data, data-as-a-service, APIs, interoperability, and FHIR is preferred.
Proven ability to conduct market discovery, create business cases, define product packaging, monetization models, and go-to-market strategies for data assets, solving complex financial and clinical pain points.
Strong understanding of product strategy, commercialization, platforms, product development lifecycles, and business planning.
Track record collaborating with cloud providers such as Azure, Databricks, AWS and or GCP to execute joint technology strategies or co-innovation initiatives with strong hybrid business and tech skills to speak with both business and engineering audiences.
Familiarity with AI/ML models, intelligent agents, and financial/clinical workflow automation including using AI tools to enhance day-to-day research, analysis, synthesis, and productivity
Experience using SQL, BI, and analytics tools to conduct exploratory analysis, validate hypotheses, and support product strategy, commercialization, and proof-of-concept activities.
Demonstrated success supporting external data partnerships, third-party vendor integrations, rapid POC commercialization, and translating multi-stakeholder mandates into scalable product capabilities.
Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with experience using frameworks to evaluate market opportunities and inform product strategy. Ability to present recommendations, business cases, product concepts, and complex information to clients, cross-functional teams, and MedInsight senior management.

jobs.description:
LDRM is seeking Research Analysts! Come join our team of outstanding professionals!

At LDRM we streamline the review, validation, compliance and submission of virtually any government-specific system application. That enables our customers to achieve predictably lower costs, greater information security, leaner operations and more effective digital government. LDRM specializes in background investigation support, records management, business automation and optimization, and administrative support.

Responsibilities

Conducts research on cases prior to these being sent for adjudication by gathering information from a variety of sources, including but not limited to: petitions, applications, and supporting documents, the internet, telephone calls, government, commercial and open-source databases.
Evaluates data sets and interpret the relevance of data gathered including numerical statistics, legal documents, and open-source material with regard to cases.
Performs analyses on research conducted and information received from various locations in an effort to identify possible fraudulent activity related to cases.
Ensures the integrity of record keeping systems and the veracity of data collected prior to entering the data into the record keeping systems.
Writes reports in a clear and concise manner that summarize the information gathered and identified during research.
Coordinates and networks with agency personnel, other government agencies, and coworkers to facilitate information sharing on cases that involve fraud or potential criminal activity.
Appropriately handles Law Enforcement Sensitive (LES) information.
Performs analyses on petitions being returned to identify trends that may be useful in future research that is being conducted prior to the cases being sent overseas.
Identifies errors and areas for improvement in memos associated with these petitions.
Maintains a working knowledge of a variety of resources that pertain to the eligibility requirements.
May be required to perform other duties as assigned to advance the unit’s mission of supporting pre-adjudication as it relates to cases.
Makes phone calls to collect information on an individualized basis, and create reports based on the information provided.
Evaluates the case at hand, analyze the specific and individualized questions needing to be asked, and execute communication based on an individualized manner (non-scripted).

Qualifications

1-2 years of related experience.
High School degree or equivalent (associate's degree or higher preferred).
Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment background investigation, including credit and criminal checks.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret government security clearance (requires U.S. citizenship).
Additional Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing in English.
Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing in Spanish (preferred).
Ability to prepare reports and analyze documents for authenticity and for evaluation against government standards.
Ability to establish effective communications with peers and with government officials.
Ability to use databases for the purpose of obtaining and validating information.
Ability to comprehend government regulations.
Ability to conduct telephonic interviews for the purpose of obtaining information and for validating petition information.
Ability to analyze and evaluate data and interview responses to prepare concise reports and records of findings.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stand; walk; sit; lift; bend; reach; carry; stoop; kneel; use hand and fingers to handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; use fingers and hands to type or write; speak; or hear.
Specific vision abilities may be required to perform the job which may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, or the ability to adjust focus.
Work Environment: Mainly office but may also include all other work environments as required.

LDRM, a joint venture comprised of Lockwood Hills Federal, an Akima company, and DTSV, is not just another technical support contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At LDRM, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

As an LDRM employee,
you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

jobs.title: Lead Applied Operations Research Analyst
jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst
to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems
that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutions
Frame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analyses
Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifacts
Work independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain experts
Work successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problems
Be willing to adapt and learn
Demonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)
Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field
Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)
Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)
Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomes
Familiarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)
Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

Secret

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret

Salary compensation range and midpoint:

$155,200 - $194,000 - $232,800 Annual

Work Location Type:

Onsite

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

Are you a data-savvy professional with an analytical mindset who thrives on exploring data and extracting insights? Do you have an aptitude for visualizing those insights and presenting them in ways that improve operational decision-making? Are you attracted to an entrepreneurial culture and energized by high growth? If so, read on.
We are seeking a Data Analyst II to join our growing Operations Analytics team.This key role will leverage both quantitative and qualitative skills to increase the organizational value of the Phoenix Service Center by influencing insight-driven decision making (Analysis), ensuring improved performance measurement (Visualization) and identifying solutions to help optimize operations (Prediction)
As you build relationships across the operation, you will be instrumental in exploring and modeling data in order to identify new opportunities for efficiency and improvement, then visualizing critical insights to improve decision making. Partnering with the operational leaders to create and design/develop performance measurement KPIs and build out the associated dashboards will also be key to gaining momentum within this role.  
You will work in areas like capacity planning, workload forecasting, workforce analytics, business impact analytics, call center analytics and customer experience analytics. To be successful in this role you must be detail-oriented, creative, innovative, consultative, willing to learn and grow and enjoy a fast-paced, challenging environment. You will benefit from having a talent for “telling the story” with data, keeping the user experience in mind, as well as exposure to data/statistical modeling, relational database utilization and data wrangling techniques.

This is a hybrid position based in our Phoenix office, with an expectation of working on-site three days per week Tuesday-Thursday.

What You'll Do:

Consult with internal operations leaders to identify problems or opportunities that can leverage data and analytics, building trusted stakeholder relationships and bringing curiosity to uncover the real business problem worth solving
Collect, analyze and interpret large data sets from various sources to answer high-impact business questions and identify patterns, trends, and insights
Perform in-depth analyses and then create data models to identify trends and key drivers that inform important decisions across the business
Apply statistical, simulation, and forecasting methods, including hypothesis testing, regression, A/B testing, Monte Carlo simulation, and time series forecasting, to quantify the impact of operational and business decisions and anticipate future outcomes
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, using visualizations and presentations to communicate insights and drive stakeholder decisions
Use data storytelling techniques to simplify complex findings into narratives that resonate with non-technical stakeholders and drive action
Manage multiple analytics projects with accuracy and attention to detail, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured, testable analytical approaches that meet stakeholder requirements and support broader use-case goals
Drive best practices to improve the quality and effectiveness of our analytics function across capacity planning, workforce analytics, and customer/call center analytics
Partner with operations leaders to define business KPIs and analytical frameworks that inform dashboards and simplify decision making
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and seek out opportunities to develop new skills

What We Look For:

Bachelor's degree in data analytics, mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience
Minimum 3+ years proven experience in data analysis and visualization, including business requirements gathering
Advanced knowledge of SQL and data query/mining techniques
Working knowledge of data modeling and database concepts, with the ability to structure and query data effectively for analysis
Experience applying statistical techniques and simulations to business problems, such as regression, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, Monte Carlo simulation, or time series forecasting
Strong storytelling and data communication skills, with the ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into simple, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences
Strong proficiency with Tableau or related data visualization tools (PowerBI, Superset, etc.)
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, including active listening and presentation
Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for ad hoc analysis
Experience in financial services is preferred
Proficiency in Python (pandas, statsmodels, or scikit-learn) for statistical analysis preferred
Experience with Contact Center Analytics and A/B testing/experimentation frameworks is a plus

What We Offer You: 

Competitive salary ($85K-$115K USD) and stock option plan
Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 
Flexible PTO
Opportunities for professional growth and development 
Paid parental leave
Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.title: Senior Applied Operations Research Analyst
jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst
to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems
that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutions
Frame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analyses
Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifacts
Work independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain experts
Work successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problems
Be willing to adapt and learn
Demonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)
Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field
Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)
Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)
Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomes
Familiarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)
Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

You Will

Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.
Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.
Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.
Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.
Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.
Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.
Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.
Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.
Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.
Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.
Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.
Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

You Have

5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.
Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.
Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.
Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.
Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.
Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

Preferred Experience

Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.
Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.
Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau), including building governed reporting layers with SLAs.
Exposure to interchange and fee/cost reconciliation, revenue-leakage detection, and tax or regulatory reporting regimes.
Experience supporting audits, internal controls, or SOX-adjacent processes, and mentoring junior analysts.
Curiosity about payments products and financial markets.

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst
to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems
that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Accumulate funds through after-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.*
Eligibility requirements vary by position.

Position Summary:

Merchandising at BJ's drives the assortment, presentation, and value story that defines the member experience across every club. Merchandising Operations translates that strategy into execution — owning space allocation, assortment planning, and the planograms that shape how products are presented on the floor.

This role supports two of the most visible and commercially important areas of the club:

Center Core
is our General Merchandise destination — a curated space built around seasonal, holiday, and high-interest categories, designed to reinforce BJ's as a source of value and newness across giftable, décor, and impulse categories.

High Value Space (HVS)
encompasses the club's highest-traffic locations — entrance, end caps, and checkout — and serves as the primary vehicle for seasonal and promotional storytelling. The entrance sets the first impression and establishes the tone for key events. End caps connect in-aisle assortment to broader themes, drive basket-building through attachment and cross-sell, and introduce new or seasonally relevant items. Checkout captures last-minute impulse with high-margin product, maximizing lane productivity while reinforcing everyday value.

The Lead Analyst is the primary analytical and reporting partner for both areas, operating at the intersection of category strategy, space productivity, and data infrastructure. The role carries a dual mandate: serve as a trusted analytical voice for Center Core and HVS decision-making, while simultaneously advancing the broader Merchandising reporting and analytics capability. Neither area has robust data infrastructure today, creating genuine greenfield opportunity to define metrics, build dashboards, and shape the analytical foundation that will drive decisions across the business. This is a high-visibility role for someone who can move between hands-on data work and clear, credible communication with cross-functional partners and leadership.

Organizationally, the role sits within Merchandising Operations with dotted-line relationships into the Center Core/HVS team and the broader Merchant organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Analytics & Decision Support

Serve as the primary analytical partner to the Center Core, HVS, and Merchant teams — translating business questions into analytical approaches and delivering insights that inform assortment, space, and promotional decisions.
Lead discovery on ambiguous or unclear questions, working through surface-level symptoms to identify root causes before making a recommendation.
Analyze category performance, space productivity, and promotional effectiveness to surface opportunities and risks; advise on strategies that optimize sales, margin, and member value.
Monitor performance against forecasts, flagging gaps early and recommending adjustments to assortment, space, or execution.

Reporting & Infrastructure

Build and own the reporting and insights infrastructure for Center Core and HVS — defining the metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that will drive category and space decisions going forward.
Identify and access certified data from the right sources across a fragmented environment — navigating systems that are not co-located or consistently governed to ensure recommendations are built on reliable inputs.
Maintain consistent standards for data sourcing, validation, and documentation across all analyses, with a strong bias toward integrity before escalating findings.

Advancing Merchandising Analytics Capability

Contribute to the broader Merchandising analytics program — participating in requirements gathering, helping define metrics and reporting standards, and informing the roadmap for expanded BI and AI-enabled capabilities across the organization.
Research and evaluate analytical methodologies relevant to incrementality, space productivity, and category performance — drawing on work from the Merchandising Analytics team, industry best practices, and third-party frameworks — and assess their applicability to Center Core and HVS.
Support data certification and governance efforts in partnership with the central data and analytics team, helping establish SLAs, metric definitions, and access frameworks that the broader merchandising organization can trust.

Job Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
5–10 years of experience in merchandising analytics, category management, retail operations, or a related field.
Strong proficiency with Excel, SQL, and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar); exposure to Databricks and SAP a plus. Comfortable working through large or messy datasets independently.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize ambiguous data into clear, actionable recommendations with minimal guidance.
Strong communicator — able to build relationships, ask the right questions to surface the true business need, and present findings in terms that resonate with both analytical and non-analytical audiences.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously.
General retail experience preferred; wholesale/club-channel and promotional analytics experience a plus.

This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days.

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $103,000.00 - $131,500.00

new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

At Snap, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is not a traditional project coordinator—this is a strategic, high-leverage leadership role designed for deep technical operators who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, data analytics, and program execution. TPMs at Snap are single-threaded owners of large-scale, high-stakes, and often ambiguous programs. They combine engineering depth with execution precision, earning visibility and trust across the company by driving outcomes that power the core of our products and infrastructure. Unlike industry-standard TPM roles, Snap TPMs are hands-on contributors who write Python notebooks, build dashboards and automation tools, and partner closely with engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, make architectural trade-offs, and drive the operating rhythm of the business. The most successful TPMs possess the ability to grasp new concepts quickly, navigate technical complexity, and adapt in fast-moving environments. This role is ideal for former engineers or data scientists who have evolved into program leaders without leaving their technical roots behind.

Our interview process reflects the technical rigor and strategic impact expected of TPMs at Snap. Unlike typical program management interviews, our process is designed to evaluate candidates’ ability to think like engineers and act like owners. Candidates begin with a technical screen with the hiring manager that dives into core program execution and engineering fundamentals. From there, The final stage is a virtual onsite, which includes a program leadership presentation and four 1:1 interviews with senior leaders across Snap. Throughout, we assess not only communication and collaboration skills but also technical fluency, first-principles thinking, and the ability to drive strategic outcomes in complex, ambiguous environments.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Snap, you will:

Lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering organizations and require deep technical understanding, rigorous execution, and strategic influence.
Operate as a single-threaded owner (STO) for the most critical programs, managing ambiguity, dependencies, and alignment across diverse technical teams.
Own the full lifecycle of programs—from ideation to execution to operational excellence—delivering outcomes that support Snap’s product, infrastructure, and platform goals.
Partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, influence technical decisions, and drive accountability.
Use hands-on data analytics (Python, SQL, dashboards, notebooks) to guide programs with data, uncover insights, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
Contribute to Snap’s technical ecosystem by building automation tools, improving internal systems, and identifying opportunities for platform-wide transformation.
Work across both development programs (spanning multiple orgs with complex interdependencies) and platform excellence programs (focused on reliability, efficiency, and performance).
Drive the operating rhythm of the business, ensuring engineering systems scale effectively while remaining cost-conscious and performant
Mentor and grow other junior TPMs and Engineers to scale the performance of the org

Bachelor's in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
6+ years of experience spanning Engineering / Data Science / Technical Program Management leading cross-functional efforts in the software or tech industry in a data-driven environment.
3+ years of experience in Technical Program Management .
A proven track record of leading large-scale, ambiguous programs across distributed teams in fast-paced, cross-functional environments, especially in the areas of improving platform reliability, operational stability and performance of production systems
Strong proficiency with Python and SQL, and experience using data to analyze systems, build tools, or inform decisions.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Grafana, Looker, Tableau) building dashboards, source control (e.g. GitHub), ticket management (e.g. JIRA).
Experience working directly with engineers and contributing to technical design, architectural trade-offs, and roadmap planning.
Comfort operating with high visibility and accountability; you thrive on ownership and impact.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new domains, systems, and technologies.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

A background in software engineering, infrastructure systems
Prior hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Hive, Kafka, or Flink.
Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization tools like Kubernetes or Docker.
Background in building internal tools or developer platforms to improve engineering velocity and system reliability.
Experience managing production systems, reliability initiatives, or cost optimization programs.
Exposure to high-scale consumer technology or social platforms with strong privacy, performance, or safety requirements.
Strong storytelling and presentation skills—especially with senior engineering or executive audiences.

Job Description

The Lead Logistics Data Analyst will lead logistics analytics and systems projects that improve service, cost, productivity, and visibility across Honeywell Aerospace. Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Logistics Data Analytics & Systems, this role combines deep knowledge of logistics operations with an understanding of how ERP, warehouse management, transportation management, and reporting systems create and move data. You will translate operational problems into practical process, data, and system solutions, guide cross-functional delivery, and make the results usable by the teams that run the operation.

Responsibilities

Lead assigned logistics analytics and systems projects from problem definition and business case through requirements, delivery, testing, adoption, and benefits tracking. Maintain plans, milestones, risks, decisions, and clear stakeholder updates.
Serve as the logistics process subject matter expert for transportation, warehousing, inventory movement, and related handoffs. Map current workflows and data flows, identify root causes, and design scalable improvements with site and functional partners.
Partner with Logistics, Integrated Supply Chain, IT, Finance, and external providers to define requirements and improve the use and integration of ERP, WMS, TMS, and adjacent systems. Validate that system changes reflect operational reality and preserve data integrity.
Lead analytics work that connects source data to business decisions. Develop or guide SQL queries, data validation, Tableau dashboards, and Python-based analysis or automation as appropriate; establish clear KPI definitions and reconcile results with source systems.
Use logistics metrics to prioritize opportunities and measure outcomes, including cost, on-time performance, warehouse productivity, inventory accuracy, capacity, and exception trends.
Coordinate user acceptance testing, documentation, training, and change management for new reports, processes, and system enhancements. Resolve issues after launch and support sustained adoption.
Identify data quality, control, and compliance risks; partner with appropriate owners on access, governance, export control, and other applicable requirements.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

At least 6 years of progressive experience in logistics or integrated supply chain operations, systems, analytics, or project delivery, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
Working knowledge of transportation and warehouse processes and the operational data generated by ERP, WMS, and TMS platforms.
Hands-on experience using SQL to investigate, reconcile, and analyze operational data and experience building business-facing dashboards in Tableau or a comparable BI platform.
Ability to lead projects across business and technical teams, communicate tradeoffs, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable improvements.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Experience with Python for data preparation, analysis, automation, or forecasting.
Experience implementing or enhancing ERP, WMS, or TMS solutions and documenting system interfaces, data mappings, and end-to-end data flows.
Experience with logistics network, carrier, warehouse, or inventory analytics in a multi-site or global environment.
Experience in aerospace or another complex, regulated supply chain.
Advanced degree, project management certification, or Lean Six Sigma experience.
Ability to coach colleagues on analytical methods and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or a person with protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon MGM Studios Financial Systems
new_jobs.description:
Description

Ready to lead the successful integration of MGM's financial systems into Amazon?

Join Amazon MGM Studios Tech as the single-threaded owner of a multi-year program that migrates MGM's financial systems and the significant balance-sheet exposure and annual P&L activity they carry, out of multiple legacy platforms and into a single consolidated Amazon architecture. The Principal Technical Program Manager is a leadership role where you'll set strategic technical direction and drive a transformative, cross-organizational initiative spanning multiple business workstreams, a large portfolio of new deal types, across several engineering organizations, and a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, with a firm deadline to fully deprecate MGM's legacy ERP and complete the integration.

What You'll Do

Own and deliver an ambiguous, very large, and complex program that spans multiple organizations and technology domains, serving as the single-threaded owner for all program-level milestones across several bespoke business workstreams (including international and domestic theatrical distribution, third-party content licensing, development and production, streaming, and production facilities).
Design and own the end-to-end data migration and cutover strategy that moves all financial data (master, transactional, and reference data) from legacy systems to the consolidated platform, spanning the full stack across business, middleware, financial automation, downstream financial infrastructure, and legacy systems to deprecate.
Develop workback plans per workstream, sequence migrations to manage operational risk, and coordinate with the studio's legal entity restructure, owning the sequencing trade-offs of its circular dependency with the program's builds.
Own the standardization and graduation framework — define deal-type primitives, establish system-of-record boundaries, enforce standard-versus-exception rules, and determine when each workstream is ready to transition from the program to BAU ownership.
Identify risks and opportunities in technical strategies, system architectures, and engineering organizational structures, resolving cross-workstream dependencies and engineering capacity gaps.
Influence and advise VP-level leadership across multiple Finance Technology and Studios Technology organizations — plus Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FinOps — on technical investment decisions, organizational alignment, and long-term platform strategy, making priority calls based on business value, partner readiness, and platform reuse.
Author the program's strategic narratives, define program-level tenets, and run the operating cadence (monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership, and ad-hoc executive escalations).
Drive clarity in a highly ambiguous environment where business strategy, architectural approach, and even the problem definition may not yet exist.

What You Bring

10+ years of technical program management experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering very large, cross-organizational programs.
Deep expertise in large-scale systems and platform architecture, and the ability to evaluate and influence architectural strategies across multiple engineering organizations.
Executive-level communication and influence skills, with experience advising VP-level leaders and aligning competing priorities across organizational boundaries — without direct line authority.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes at scale.
Experience making irreversible sequencing decisions in complex migrations and managing controllership and operational risk.

Why This Role Matters

As the Principal TPM for this program, you won't just execute, you'll define how MGM's financial systems are successfully integrated into Amazon and rebuilt for the next decade. You'll make the irreversible calls: which businesses cut over first, when to freeze legacy systems, how to manage the circular dependency between the entity restructure and the program's builds, and which requirements to simplify without impacting customers. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives alignment across senior leaders with competing roadmaps, and delivers outsized, measurable business value and productivity impact.

This role reports to a Senior Manager of Software Development and regularly presents to VP-level leadership across the program's Steering Committee.

Join us in building the future of entertainment finance!

About The Team

Prime Video (PV) Financial Systems (FinSys) calculates, pays, receives payments, accounts for and reports all financial activities to operate a digital streaming and studios business. We manage the onboarding of commercial contractual terms and enable seamless monetization of content and assets through mechanisms like PV related purchases, rentals, subscriptions, ads and theatrical releases. We are successful when we have earned the trust of our customers and they are delighted with our solutions. This drives selection growth for Prime Video and the other businesses we support.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
10+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience working at a TV Network, broadcaster, or an online streaming platform, specializing in digital video delivery or streaming media technologies
