new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Technology
new_jobs.description:
Brio Water Technology, a Home Organizers, Inc. company,
is a market leading water products brand that has helped millions stay hydrated through its unique and innovative product line. We offer full home water solutions designed to elevate the way people hydrate, combining sophisticated technology with modern, top tier design to deliver exceptional performance, customer satisfaction, and enhanced functionality.

Home Organizers, Inc.
is the parent organization behind a portfolio of well-known home products and services brands, including Closet World, Closets by Design, Brio Water Technology, and others. With decades of experience supporting innovation, design, manufacturing, and customer focused solutions, Home Organizers helps its brands deliver high quality products and services that improve everyday living for households across the country.

About the role

As part of Home Organizers, Inc., Brio Water Technology is looking for a Program Manager, Technology to build the program governance, standards, and processes that do not yet exist within our technology organization. This is a foundational, hands-on role for someone who walks into ambiguity and sees opportunity rather than a problem.

This role is deliberately two jobs in one. As the business analyst, you define the problem, outline the scope, and make sure the solution fits what the business actually needs. As the program manager, you own the budget, hold the timeline, and deliver through the team. We are looking for someone who does both, and who knows which one a given moment calls for.

The right person starts with people, not plans: they talk to our internal customers, learn their pain points, understand the current state, and use what they learn to design the processes and procedures we do not yet have. They are proactive by default. Wherever there is a compliance concern, an undocumented procedure, or a process with no owner, they step in, create clarity, and carry it until a permanent owner is in place. They do not wait to be assigned work; they find the gaps, close them, and hand them off.

This person arrives with Agile coaching experience already in hand. As our teams mature and grow, they will take on Scrum Master duties and coach teams of varying size and experience. All of it requires influence without authority, and comfort operating alongside senior leaders and executives who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems actually behave.

Objectives of the role

Establish the program governance, standards, and compliance foundation our technology organization does not yet have, in close partnership with internal stakeholders.
Take ownership of gaps: compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and unowned processes, creating clarity and carrying them until a permanent owner is in place.
Lead cross-functional technology programs end to end, from problem definition and requirements through delivery, coordinating teams and vendors outside your direct management chain.
Take on the role of Scrum Master, Agile Coach, and business analyst for one or more teams as our organization matures.

What you'll do

Strategic planning.
Define the roadmap, goals, and long-term vision for assigned programs, and sequence the work so near-term delivery builds toward the target state.
Business analysis.
Define the problem before the solution is chosen. Elicit and document requirements, map current and future state, set scope, and write acceptance criteria, confirming that what gets built fits what the business actually needs.
Stakeholder communication.
Serve as the primary bridge between project teams, executives, and external partners. Run working sessions, keep everyone current on status, risks, and decisions, and work directly with stakeholders up to the executive level and with subject matter experts who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems behave.
Change management and adoption.
Many of our teams have worked in the same systems, using the same processes, for a very long time. Adoption here is earned, not announced. Communicate change early and often, brief the leadership of each area before rollout so their questions are answered ahead of go-live, and provide the training and hands-on support people need to work confidently in the new process. Success is measured by adoption, not by the go-live date.
Program delivery.
Lead cross-functional technology programs end to end: system implementations, migrations, and infrastructure initiatives, coordinating teams outside your direct management chain, including external vendors, internal business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
Cross-project coordination.
Manage interdependencies across concurrent projects, surface scheduling and resource conflicts early, and drive them to resolution.
Budget oversight.
Allocate resources, forecast expenses, and own budget adherence and variance tracking for assigned programs, including vendor software licensing, capital expenses for infrastructure upgrades, and cloud costs.
Risk management.
Identify roadblocks and risks early and implement corrective action. Maintain the risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit-ready documentation.
Governance and gap ownership.
Stand up program governance where none exists today. Proactively identify compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and processes without a clear owner; create interim structure, carry ownership, and hand off to permanent owners once established.
Agile leadership.
Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, coaching teams of varying size and maturity as the organization scales.

Qualifications

3-5 years of program or project management experience, including managing individual program or project budgets between $250,000 and $1,000,000.
Cross-functional IT program delivery: has led system implementations, migrations, or infrastructure programs end to end, across teams they did not manage, including teams that spanned external vendors and internal SMEs.
Compliance and governance experience: has operated inside an audited or regulated environment (for example SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or SOC 2) and can re-create the artifacts it runs on: risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit evidence. Prior authorship of these artifacts is not required; applied familiarity is.
Business analysis and business partner engagement: has gathered and documented requirements, run working sessions, and translated business needs into technical scope, working directly with stakeholders up to the executive level.
Hands-on Agile delivery experience and demonstrated Agile coaching experience, with the ability to serve as Scrum Master for one or more teams as the organization grows.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, current and in good standing.

Preferred Skills

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
Familiarity with formal change-management methodologies and stakeholder-management practices.

This role is in Louisville, KY or Maple Grove, MN
The workday will begin around 7:00AM
The role works a 9/80 schedule where you will have every other Friday off

Managing scope to achieve cost/profitability, schedule, and technical performance objectives
Performing as a Control Account Manager (CAM)
Establishing program direction for the matrixed team delivering the scope (operations including supply chain and manufacturing, engineering, field service, and/or others)
Proactively planning for activities on current and future contracts
Monitoring and controlling activities on current contracts including disciplined, effective change management
Actively and effectively managing risks and opportunities
Indirectly managing and leading program team members across several functions

Responsible for completion of deliverables and on-time delivery
With respect to production, manages material for and manufacturing of hardware including final processing, shipment and delivery planning and coordination, and quality and export reviews

Partners with project controls to develop and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and manages program team’s performance to the IMS

Supports recurring status meetings with the program team and customer and program review meetings with business and customer leadership
Hosts customer meetings at the Louisville factory and our Minneapolis location including coordinating visits with export and security functions
Facilitates and attends source inspections and other supplier/subcontractor meetings and/or visits
Flexes schedule due to time zone differences when supporting customer meetings
Successfully navigates through cultural differences to understand unique customer customs, expectations, values, and priorities

Bachelor’s Degree and 6 years of work experience or equivalent experience
Customer focus and relationship building skills
Interest in deepening international culture awareness, understanding, and experience
Experience in Project Management
Experience in Scope Management
Knowledge of project management methodologies, toolsets, process, and governance
Ability to develop and implement effective program/project plans specifying goals, staffing, scheduling, identification of risks, contingency plans, and allocation of available resources
Ability to initiate, prioritize, and coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously
Ability to achieve program objectives using a team-based approach that demonstrates the value of each team member
Ability to operate independently and proactively

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

International business knowledge
International culture awareness, understanding, and experience
Graduate Degree
Professional Certifications (PMP)
Experience in Defense (DoD)/Government Contracting
Experience in a Firm Fixed Price Environment
Experience in Engineering/Technology
Experience in Operational Excellence (OE)
Experience in Control Account Management (CAM)
Experience in Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)
Experience in Lifecycle Management (LCM)
Experience in Oracle or ERP
Advanced Excel skills

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Platforms & Services

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

The Platforms & Services (P&S) sector under BAE Systems, Inc does the big stuff: the armored combat vehicles, naval guns, missile launchers, and naval ship repair…just to name a few. Our employees take pride in the work they do and why they do it. They are on the front lines every day, building our products to protect the lives of those who serve. new_jobs.title: Lead Federal Project Manager - Federal Transformation Office (FTO)
new_jobs.description:
Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

The FTO connects teams across Oracle to improve how Federal Consulting delivers. The office removes barriers, connects expertise, and advances systemic solutions across four areas: delivery excellence, operational improvement, automation and time to value, and reporting and tooling.

As a Lead Federal Project Manager, you will independently lead multiple FTO initiatives end-to-end, from request intake and planning through implementation, adoption, and closure. You will translate broad priorities and recurring delivery challenges into actionable plans, coordinate accountable owners, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries. You will lead the assigned transformation projects and coordinate the changes needed to help those teams succeed.

This role requires an experienced project leader who understands Federal program environments, navigates ambiguity, and earns trust with senior leaders and working teams. You will partner with FTO functional leads, Oracle Health Government Services, Federal Consulting, and additional teams such as product, engineering, support, and hosting to advance Federal priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Lead multiple complex FTO projects across delivery, operations, technology, reporting, and transformation enablement, adapting your approach to each initiative while maintaining consistent project discipline.
Translate program priorities and stakeholder requests into clear problem statements, scope, deliverables, success measures, schedules, resource needs, and accountable owners. Manage dependencies and changes across concurrent initiatives.
Apply the FTO request management process: intake, triage, assign ownership, take action, and report back. Work with functional leads and governance partners to prioritize requests and maintain visibility through resolution.
Drive execution of project plans through cross-functional working sessions, milestone reviews, and action tracking. Identify blockers early, resolve issues with the appropriate owners, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
Maintain accurate project records in Jira and established FTO tools, including milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action owners. Provide a reliable view of progress and delivery health.
Prepare concise executive updates and materials for FTO governance forums and VA readouts through established stakeholder channels. Communicate results, near-term risks, and decisions needed, and close the feedback loop with requestors and impacted teams.

Key Responsibilities Continued

Lead process improvement efforts that address recurring delivery and operational challenges. Partner with subject matter experts to understand root causes, simplify handoffs, and implement sustainable solutions.

Here's the impact you'll make and what we'll accomplish together

As a Business Analyst and expert in your field, you will use your subject matter and technical expertise to design and develop training and implementation programs, resources, and strategies to optimize training and implementation outcomes for our clients and teams. Here's how

Manage, design and develop training materials and learning solutions to ensure documentation and programs are current and relevant given market changes and evolution
Proactively identify opportunities in training curriculum given business developments and evolutions
Deliver training events and learning solutions using all mediums including onsite, e-learning, virtual facilitation, and blended models
Use in-depth knowledge on settings, configurations, add-on modules, and pricing to ensure stores are maximizing the efficiency of their pharmacy application
Consult on complex implementation projects and collaborate with the stakeholders at varying levels of seniority to understand objectives/strategies and desired results
Travel across Canada to provide onsite training and project support when needed, ensuring appropriate travel arrangements to allow for prompt scheduled arrival at pharmacies

Identify and escalate issues quickly through appropriate channels
Work independently and take initiative to solution new challenges faced by the team
Thrive and promote a team environment of collaboration and cooperation, as you help maintain our core supportive team culture

You're the missing piece of the puzzle

Fully Bilingual in English and French, written and oral skills
Excellent interpersonnel and communication skills
Has strong coaching, facilitation, and teaching skills
Proven expertise using and troubleshooting the Kroll pharmacy applications
Experience working in a pharmacy environment
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with demonstrated punctuality and reliability
Ability to work independently and with minimal direction
Resilient, agile and flexible to change

Experience working with data conversions to the Kroll software from other pharmacy software solutions
Has a valid driver's license, has unlimited access to a vehicle, and can legally rent a car in all provinces and territories

A demonstrated knowledge in troubleshooting Kroll software issues
Experience in adult education or in designing training programs
Experience working with other pharmacy solutions or tools
Familiarity with Salesforce and Google tools

new_jobs.title: Product Strategist – New and Emerging Products (MedInsight)
new_jobs.description:
Individual(s) must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for immigration support or sponsorship from Milliman now or in the future.

Company Overview

Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our purpose is to empower easy, data-driven decision-making on important healthcare questions. Through our products, education, and services, MedInsight is making an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing waste. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.

MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.

Position Summary

Milliman MedInsight is seeking a Product Strategist to support the development and commercialization of emerging healthcare data, workflow, and AI-enabled decision-support products, with a strong focus on 0-to-1 opportunities and emerging product lines. This role serves as a collaborative bridge between data products, technology partners, and downstream product lines, working across payer, provider, clinical, GMs, and technical product management teams to incubate differentiated products. The Product Strategist will translate market needs and business priorities into actionable product strategies, leveraging internal capabilities, external data assets, and technology partnerships to advance innovative concepts into scalable, market-ready solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

Product Incubation & Commercialization: Develop business cases, product definitions, and product concept memos for assigned opportunities, articulating the market opportunity, target buyer, value proposition, competitive differentiation, proposed solution, and path to commercialization. Drive incubation of emerging healthcare data, workflow, and AI-enabled decision-support products that may leverage hyperscalers, technology partners, intelligent agents, and reusable platform capabilities as delivery mechanisms.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with payer, provider, clinical, general managers, technical product management, and engineering stakeholders to align customer value propositions with the underlying data, models, workflows, delivery mechanisms, and compliance requirements.
Product Roadmap Development: Support product roadmap development in collaboration with Technical Product Managers by documenting capabilities, dependencies and priorities.
Strategic Partnerships: Support execution with technology partners (such as Databricks) and external partners to prototype, execute joint data strategies, and accelerate enterprise/build capabilities.
Build vs Partner Evaluation: Collaborate with lead Strategic Product Managers such as Payer, Provider and Clinical to identify where software partnerships may advance path to market/differentiation. Support partner sourcing, capability evaluation, and business and technical due diligence.
Discovery and Market Synthesis: Conduct market, customer, and competitive research to identify emerging opportunities and inform product and portfolio strategy.
Data Acquisition & Ecosystem Sourcing: Support business value articulation, evaluation, and onboarding of external data assets and partnerships to enrich the core assets and expand addressable market use cases.
Proof-of-Concept Design & Prototyping: Drive the execution and evaluation of technical and commercial proof-of-concepts (POCs) with partners to mitigate risk of new product initiatives before full-scale engineering investment.
Product Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a product subject matter expert supporting internal training, client discussions, pre-sales and sales activities, and commercialization efforts as appropriate.
Responsible Innovation: Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage dependencies, and ensure assigned initiatives meet data-governance, privacy, contractual, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, computer science, engineering or related field.
5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, strategy consulting, commercialization, or a related discipline, preferably within enterprise software, healthcare data and analytics, or technology-enabled services. Experience with clinical and pharmacy data, data-as-a-service, APIs, interoperability, and FHIR is preferred.
Proven ability to conduct market discovery, create business cases, define product packaging, monetization models, and go-to-market strategies for data assets, solving complex financial and clinical pain points.
Strong understanding of product strategy, commercialization, platforms, product development lifecycles, and business planning.
Track record collaborating with cloud providers such as Azure, Databricks, AWS and or GCP to execute joint technology strategies or co-innovation initiatives with strong hybrid business and tech skills to speak with both business and engineering audiences.
Familiarity with AI/ML models, intelligent agents, and financial/clinical workflow automation including using AI tools to enhance day-to-day research, analysis, synthesis, and productivity
Experience using SQL, BI, and analytics tools to conduct exploratory analysis, validate hypotheses, and support product strategy, commercialization, and proof-of-concept activities.
Demonstrated success supporting external data partnerships, third-party vendor integrations, rapid POC commercialization, and translating multi-stakeholder mandates into scalable product capabilities.
Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with experience using frameworks to evaluate market opportunities and inform product strategy. Ability to present recommendations, business cases, product concepts, and complex information to clients, cross-functional teams, and MedInsight senior management.

Location:

This is a remote position. Candidates hired into this role may work remotely anywhere in the US. The expected application deadline for this job is October 30, 2026.

Compensation

The overall salary range for this role is $93,700 - $177,675. For candidates residing in:

Alaska, California, Connecticut, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York City, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Washington, or the District of Columbia, the salary range is $107,755 - $177,675.
All other locations the salary range is $93,700 - $154,500

A combination of factors will be considered, including, but not limited to, education, relevant work experience, qualifications, skills, certifications, etc.

What makes this a great opportunity?

Join an innovative, high growth company with a solid industry track record
Bring your expertise and ideas to directly impact and help build the next generation of MedInsight products and solutions
Be recognized for your contributions and impact
Work for a company that values your wellbeing and professional growth, offering a flexible work environment, generous benefits package, and investment in the development of your career

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees’ health, financial security, and well-being. Benefits include:

Medical, Dental and Vision – Coverage for employees, dependents, and domestic partners
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential support for personal and work-related challenges
401(k) Plan – Includes a company matching program and profit-sharing contributions.
Discretionary Bonus Program – Recognizing employee contributions
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) – Pre-tax savings for dependent care, transportation, and eligible medical expenses
Paid Time Off (PTO) – Begins accruing on the first day of work. Full-time employees accrue 15 days per year, and employees working less than full-time accrue PTO on a prorated basis
Holidays – A minimum of 10 paid holidays per year
Family Building Benefits – Includes adoption and fertility assistance
Paid Parental Leave – Up to 11 weeks of paid leave for employees who meet eligibility criteria
Life Insurance & AD&D – 100% of premiums covered by Milliman
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability – Fully paid by Milliman

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

new_jobs.description:
LDRM is seeking Research Analysts! Come join our team of outstanding professionals!

At LDRM we streamline the review, validation, compliance and submission of virtually any government-specific system application. That enables our customers to achieve predictably lower costs, greater information security, leaner operations and more effective digital government. LDRM specializes in background investigation support, records management, business automation and optimization, and administrative support.

Responsibilities

Conducts research on cases prior to these being sent for adjudication by gathering information from a variety of sources, including but not limited to: petitions, applications, and supporting documents, the internet, telephone calls, government, commercial and open-source databases.
Evaluates data sets and interpret the relevance of data gathered including numerical statistics, legal documents, and open-source material with regard to cases.

new_jobs.title: Lead Applied Operations Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst
to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems
that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutions
Frame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analyses
Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifacts
Work independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain experts
Work successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problems
Be willing to adapt and learn
Demonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)
Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field
Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)
Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)
Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomes
Familiarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)
Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

Secret

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret

Salary compensation range and midpoint:

$155,200 - $194,000 - $232,800 Annual

Work Location Type:

Onsite

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

Guggenheim is seeking a qualified candidate as a sell-side Equity Research Analyst covering the Media and Internet industries. The coverage group includes many of the largest corporations in the sector including Alphabet, Netflix, The Walt Disney Company and Spotify. The team strives to serve investors on the leading edge of these industries, as reflected in recent coverage expansion including Reddit and Universal Music Group.

This person will be responsible for following the progress of public and private media companies and supporting the Senior Research Analyst and will be expected to develop a thorough understanding of the dynamic coverage universe. In addition to excellent writing skills, financial modeling, and communication skills, the ideal candidate will demonstrate high aptitude for gathering and synthesizing relevant primary market data. Candidate must be able to demonstrate a willingness to conduct ongoing independent market research and related industry networking. The ability to convey an investment message through a written research report is key to the success of this hire.

Essential Job Functions

Analyze individual Digital, Media and Entertainment companies and market trends
Conduct primary research, including but not limited to: financial analysis, due diligence on industry trends, company management, and strategies
Draft reports/notes on relevant investment themes, events, and breaking news
Prepare regular written research reports that summarize the findings of analysis, including estimates of expected current year business results
Provide support to the Senior Analyst through fundamental analysis with an emphasis on original, bottoms-up research in the Media and Internet sectors
Contribute to building valuation models
Write notes in response to daily news flow, keep the Senior Analyst up-to-date on important news and adjust financial models and files to reflect latest information
Update analyst marketing handout regularly
Organize calls for investors and investor events.
Interact with the Firm’s institutional sales force and investor clients
Respond to client and internal inquiries regarding research findings and directives

Basic Qualifications

2026 or 2027 BA/BS Degree
Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and familiarity with AI applications
Must have or obtain Series 7, 63, 86 and 87 licenses within 6 months of hire
Experience in modeling financial statements, including forecasting product revenues; familiarity with discounted cash flows, valuation, and net present value calculations; ability to analyze large sets of data to determine trends and strong conclusions
Understanding of capital markets and stock markets, and a passion for investing

Preferred Qualifications

Comfortable with large data sets and reporting
Outstanding analytical skills; ability to conduct deep primary research, analysis, and draw conclusions from information
Excellent written and oral communication skills to successfully convey investment messages, ideas, or nuances to team members, salespeople, and/or traders
Strong interpersonal relationship skills and style conducive to building relationships
Ability to thrive in a fast- paced, deadline-driven environment; self-starter with a proven commitment to producing high quality work
Team oriented, unquestionable honesty and integrity, intellectual curiosity, and dedication to providing clients with the best products
Ability to deliver under pressure and meet deadlines effectively

Work Location

Currently, this role is expected to be in the ­­­­Richmond, Virginia office at least 4 days per week.

Salary

Annual base salary of $100,000.

Guggenheim Securities is the investment banking and capital markets business of Guggenheim Partners, a global investment and advisory firm. Guggenheim Securities offers services that fall into four broad categories: Advisory, Financing, Sales and Trading, and Research. Guggenheim Securities is headquartered in New York, with additional offices in Chicago, Boston, Atlanta, San Francisco, and Houston.

Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst
to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems
that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Frame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analyses

Work successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires 4 days a week on site

Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field
Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)

new_jobs.description:
We are always seeking talented, motivated, growth-minded, and creative individuals. Our firm is committed to providing employee support and advancement, while embracing inclusion and innovation as keys to a stronger future.

We invite you to explore the position below and to submit your application to join our team!

The eMerge Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting and advancing the operational aspects of the eMerge department and eMerge Attorney Case Managers, which focuses on providing legal and technical services to clients related to eDiscovery, data management, AI, and data analysis. The eMerge Operations Analyst provides dedicated operational oversight for matter status tracking, rates, estimates, budgets, and related client communications to help ensure deadlines, responsiveness expectations, and client-service standards are consistently met. The eMerge Operations Analyst supports case teams by creating structure around case status, budget and estimate tracking, cost-savings reporting, tools used, and other operational updates, allowing eMerge Attorney Case Managers to focus on high-value legal, strategic, and client-facing responsibilities.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Coordinate the administrative lifecycle of eMerge matters, including new matter intake, conflicts coordination, matter setup, and related operational steps.
Monitor key operational metrics and identify patterns, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Maintain operational oversight of matter rates, estimates, and budgets, including tracking status, identifying issues, and coordinating timely communication with case teams and stakeholders.
Create, track, and communicate matter status updates, including upcoming deadlines, responsiveness expectations, budget and estimate updates, cost-savings information, tools used, and other key operational details.
Provide operational support that removes administrative and tracking burdens from eMerge Attorney Case Managers where added structure and follow-through are needed to protect client care and service consistency.
Support operating initiatives (e.g., process changes, tool rollouts, reporting enhancements) using an impact‑focused prioritization approach that balances client service, risk, and effort.
Support the Director of eMerge Operations with eMerge operational reporting needs, including dashboards, analyses, and presentations for firm and practice leadership.
Use sound judgment in determining which stakeholders to involve for each initiative or issue, ensuring the right individuals are directed when responsible party and appropriate stakeholders are included for visibility.
Facilitate alignment and coordination between eMerge and other firm teams (e.g., IT, Finance, Marketing, Innovation) to support seamless service delivery.
Regularly review existing eMerge operational workflows, including matter intake, reporting, vendor management, and internal coordination, to identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and reduce friction.
Develop and present actionable, solution‑oriented recommendations, including proposed process changes, templates, checklists, and tools, and support implementation and adoption efforts.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in eDiscovery, legal operations, and data management, and recommend enhancements to processes and technologies.
Assist with training and provide guidance to legal and administrative staff on eMerge tools, processes, and best practices for eDiscovery, data management, and matter workflows.
Support the creation and maintenance of clear documentation related to eMerge processes, procedures, and communication protocols.
Approach every interaction with a client‑service‑first mindset, balancing responsiveness, quality, and risk management.
Maintain confidential information with discretion and in accordance with firm policies.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong organizational and time management abilities; able to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate clearly and professionally with attorneys, staff, and administrative departments.
Ability to communicate clearly and proactively regarding matter status, budget and estimate updates, deadlines, risks, and next steps.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive relationships at all levels within the firm.
Exercises sound judgment in involving stakeholders so that communication is clearly directed at the responsible party and the appropriate stakeholders stay informed.
Demonstrated ability to analyze operational issues, interpret data/metrics, and develop practical, solution-oriented recommendations.
Ability to triage routine operational issues and escalate complex matters appropriately.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint); comfort working with data and creating reports and presentations.
Comfort developing and maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, and summaries that support matter oversight, budget awareness, cost-savings visibility, and operational accountability.
Detail‑oriented with a proactive, solution‑driven approach to problem‑solving; consistently presents options and recommendations rather than problems alone.
Strong commitment to ethical conduct, confidentiality, and organizational values.
Committed to high standards of excellence and proven results; demonstrates a sense of ownership and accountability.
High level of energy and professionalism with well‑developed interpersonal strengths and a client‑service orientation.
Ability to adapt and flex ways of working in response to changing priorities, while maintaining focus on high‑impact activities.
Familiarity with eDiscovery, litigation support, or legal operations processes; experience with related tools and systems is preferred.
Understands the broader legal ecosystem and the evolving role of technology, AI, data, and legal operations to shape service delivery and client expectations while delivering efficient, high-quality client service.
Client-service-first mindset and strong follow-through.

Bachelor’s degree, or any combination of training, education, and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position.
Minimum two (2) years of experience in eDiscovery, litigation support, legal operations, or a related professional services environment, including experience supporting operational workflows, reporting, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination.

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

You Will

Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.
Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.
Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.
Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.
Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.
Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.
Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.
Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.
Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.
Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.
Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.
Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

You Have

5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.
Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.
Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.
Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.
Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.
Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

Preferred Experience

Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.
Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.
Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau), including building governed reporting layers with SLAs.
Exposure to interchange and fee/cost reconciliation, revenue-leakage detection, and tax or regulatory reporting regimes.
Experience supporting audits, internal controls, or SOX-adjacent processes, and mentoring junior analysts.
Curiosity about payments products and financial markets.

new_jobs.title: Intermediate Applied Operations Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst
to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems
that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutions
Frame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analyses
Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifacts
Work independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain experts
Work successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problems
Be willing to adapt and learn
Demonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)
Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)
Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field
Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)
Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)
Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomes
Familiarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)
Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

Secret

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret

$98,800 - $123,500 - $148,200 Annual

Onsite

new_jobs.description:
A World-Class Team

BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.

We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:

Weekly Pay: Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms.
Free BJ’s Memberships: Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.*
Generous Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.*
Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits: Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.*
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).*
Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Accumulate funds through after-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.*
Eligibility requirements vary by position.

Position Summary:

Merchandising at BJ's drives the assortment, presentation, and value story that defines the member experience across every club. Merchandising Operations translates that strategy into execution — owning space allocation, assortment planning, and the planograms that shape how products are presented on the floor.

This role supports two of the most visible and commercially important areas of the club:

Center Core
is our General Merchandise destination — a curated space built around seasonal, holiday, and high-interest categories, designed to reinforce BJ's as a source of value and newness across giftable, décor, and impulse categories.

High Value Space (HVS)
encompasses the club's highest-traffic locations — entrance, end caps, and checkout — and serves as the primary vehicle for seasonal and promotional storytelling. The entrance sets the first impression and establishes the tone for key events. End caps connect in-aisle assortment to broader themes, drive basket-building through attachment and cross-sell, and introduce new or seasonally relevant items. Checkout captures last-minute impulse with high-margin product, maximizing lane productivity while reinforcing everyday value.

The Lead Analyst is the primary analytical and reporting partner for both areas, operating at the intersection of category strategy, space productivity, and data infrastructure. The role carries a dual mandate: serve as a trusted analytical voice for Center Core and HVS decision-making, while simultaneously advancing the broader Merchandising reporting and analytics capability. Neither area has robust data infrastructure today, creating genuine greenfield opportunity to define metrics, build dashboards, and shape the analytical foundation that will drive decisions across the business. This is a high-visibility role for someone who can move between hands-on data work and clear, credible communication with cross-functional partners and leadership.

Organizationally, the role sits within Merchandising Operations with dotted-line relationships into the Center Core/HVS team and the broader Merchant organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Analytics & Decision Support

Serve as the primary analytical partner to the Center Core, HVS, and Merchant teams — translating business questions into analytical approaches and delivering insights that inform assortment, space, and promotional decisions.
Lead discovery on ambiguous or unclear questions, working through surface-level symptoms to identify root causes before making a recommendation.
Analyze category performance, space productivity, and promotional effectiveness to surface opportunities and risks; advise on strategies that optimize sales, margin, and member value.
Monitor performance against forecasts, flagging gaps early and recommending adjustments to assortment, space, or execution.

Reporting & Infrastructure

Build and own the reporting and insights infrastructure for Center Core and HVS — defining the metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that will drive category and space decisions going forward.
Identify and access certified data from the right sources across a fragmented environment — navigating systems that are not co-located or consistently governed to ensure recommendations are built on reliable inputs.
Maintain consistent standards for data sourcing, validation, and documentation across all analyses, with a strong bias toward integrity before escalating findings.

Advancing Merchandising Analytics Capability

Contribute to the broader Merchandising analytics program — participating in requirements gathering, helping define metrics and reporting standards, and informing the roadmap for expanded BI and AI-enabled capabilities across the organization.
Research and evaluate analytical methodologies relevant to incrementality, space productivity, and category performance — drawing on work from the Merchandising Analytics team, industry best practices, and third-party frameworks — and assess their applicability to Center Core and HVS.
Support data certification and governance efforts in partnership with the central data and analytics team, helping establish SLAs, metric definitions, and access frameworks that the broader merchandising organization can trust.

Job Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
5–10 years of experience in merchandising analytics, category management, retail operations, or a related field.
Strong proficiency with Excel, SQL, and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar); exposure to Databricks and SAP a plus. Comfortable working through large or messy datasets independently.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize ambiguous data into clear, actionable recommendations with minimal guidance.
Strong communicator — able to build relationships, ask the right questions to surface the true business need, and present findings in terms that resonate with both analytical and non-analytical audiences.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously.
General retail experience preferred; wholesale/club-channel and promotional analytics experience a plus.

This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days.

In accordance with the Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the compensation range for this position. At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $103,000.00 - $131,500.00

We recognize the growing role of AI tools, including ChatGPT, and value familiarity with them. That said, we want to hear from your authentic self. Your application should reflect your own skills, experiences, and insights rather than AI-generated responses.

Design, build, and maintain automated workflows in Alteryx to replace manual, spreadsheet-driven processes.

Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and complex formulas, and comfort working with large data sets.

Prior tax experience or exposure to financial services or trading environments.
